title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四: 高宗上
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四: 高宗上 Volume 4 Annals 4: Gaozong 1

sentences.zh: 高宗天皇大聖大弘孝皇帝，諱治，太宗第九子也，母曰文德順聖長孫皇后。

translations.literal: Gaozong, Emperor Tensho the Great Sage, Greatly Broad and Filial, bore the taboo name Zhi; he was Taizong's ninth son; his mother was Empress Wende the Shunsheng of the Zhangsun clan.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong, posthumously styled Emperor Tensho the Great Sage, Greatly Broad and Filial, bore the taboo name Zhi. He was Taizong's ninth son; his mother was Empress Wende the Shunsheng of the Zhangsun clan.

sentences.zh: 以貞觀二年六月，生於東宮之麗正殿。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Zhenguan he was born in the Lizheng Hall of the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Zhenguan 2 he was born in the Lizheng Hall of the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 五年，封晉王。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was created Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 七年，遙授並州都督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed from afar as Military Governor of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he received the distant appointment as Military Governor of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 幼而岐嶷端審，寬仁孝友。

translations.literal: From childhood he was precocious, composed, broad, benevolent, filial, and friendly.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he was sharp and steady, open-handed, benevolent, filial, and loyal to his kin.

sentences.zh: 初授《孝經》於著作郎蕭德言，太宗問曰：「此書中何言為要？

translations.literal: He first received instruction in the Classic of Filial Piety from Master of Writing Xiao Deyan; Taizong asked, "What passage in this book is essential?
translations.idiomatic: He first studied the Classic of Filial Piety under Master of Writing Xiao Deyan. Taizong asked, "What passage in this book matters most?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「夫孝，始於事親，中於事君，終於立身。

translations.literal: " He replied, "Filial piety begins in serving one's parents, centers in serving one's lord, and ends in establishing oneself.
translations.idiomatic: " Deyan answered, "Filial piety begins with honoring one's parents, finds its center in serving one's lord, and ends in making a life of one's own.

sentences.zh: 君子之事上，進思盡忠，退思補過，將順其美，匡救其惡。

translations.literal: In serving his superiors the gentleman, when advancing, thinks how to exhaust loyalty; when withdrawing, thinks how to remedy faults; he follows what is good in them and corrects what is evil.
translations.idiomatic: A gentleman serving his ruler, when in office, strives to give full loyalty; when out of office, weighs how to repair his faults—he furthers what is good in the ruler and rescues him from what is bad.

sentences.zh: 」太宗大悅曰：「行此，足以事父兄，為臣子矣。

translations.literal: " Taizong was greatly pleased and said, "Put this into practice and you will be fit to serve father and elder brothers and to be a minister and son.
translations.idiomatic: " Taizong was delighted and said, "Live by that, and you will be fit to serve father and brothers and to stand as a minister and son.

sentences.zh: 」及文德皇后崩，晉王時年九歲，哀慕感動左右，太宗屢加慰撫，由是特深寵異。

translations.literal: " When Empress Wende died, the Prince of Jin was then nine years old; his grief and longing moved those beside him; Taizong repeatedly comforted him, and from this showed him exceptional favor.
translations.idiomatic: " When Empress Wende died, the Prince of Jin was nine; his mourning touched all who saw him. Taizong comforted him again and again, and from then on favored him above the rest.

sentences.zh: 尋拜右武候大將軍。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 十七年，皇太子承乾廢，魏王泰亦以罪黜，太宗與長孫無忌、房玄齡、李勣等計議，立晉王為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the Heir Apparent Chengqian was deposed; the Prince of Wei, Tai, was also dismissed for crime; Taizong deliberated with Zhangsun Wuji, Fang Xuanling, Li Ji, and others and established the Prince of Jin as Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Heir Apparent Chengqian was deposed and Prince of Wei Tai was disgraced and removed. Taizong consulted Zhangsun Wuji, Fang Xuanling, Li Ji, and others and set up the Prince of Jin as heir.

sentences.zh: 太宗每視朝，常令在側，觀決庶政，或令參議，太宗數稱其善。

translations.literal: Whenever Taizong attended court he regularly had him at his side to observe the deciding of common affairs, or had him join in deliberation; Taizong often praised his excellence.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Taizong held court he kept the heir at his side to watch the dispatch of ordinary business, or called him into counsel; Taizong often praised his judgment.

sentences.zh: 十八年，太宗將伐高麗，命太子留鎮定州。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when Taizong was about to campaign against Goguryeo, he ordered the Heir Apparent to remain and guard Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, as Taizong prepared to attack Goguryeo, he left the heir to hold Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 及駕發有期，悲啼累日，因請飛驛遞表起居，並遞敕垂報，並許之。

translations.literal: When the imperial departure was fixed, he wept for many days; he therefore asked to send urgent dispatches with memorials on the emperor's well-being and to receive edicts in return by the same route, and all was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When the day of departure was set, the heir wept for days and begged leave to use flying relays for health memorials and to receive edicts by the same route; Taizong granted both.

sentences.zh: 飛表奏事，自此始也。

translations.literal: Flying memorials to report affairs began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The practice of urgent memorials by relay began here.

sentences.zh: 及軍旋，太子從至並州。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the Heir Apparent followed to Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the army came back, the heir followed to Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 時太宗患癰，太子親吮之，扶輦步從數日。

translations.literal: At that time Taizong suffered from a carbuncle; the Heir Apparent personally sucked the pus and for several days supported the carriage and walked in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong was then afflicted with a carbuncle; the heir sucked the wound himself and for days walked beside the carriage, steadying it.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二十三年二十三年五月己巳，太宗崩。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Zhenguan, on the fifth month, day jisi, Taizong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Zhenguan, on jisi of the fifth month, Taizong died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以禮部尚書、兼太子少師、黎陽縣公於志寧為侍中，太子少詹事、兼尚書左丞張行成為兼侍中、檢校刑部尚書，太子右庶子、兼吏部侍郎、攝戶部尚書高季輔為兼中書令、檢校吏部尚書，太子左庶子、高陽縣男許敬宗兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Yu Zhining, Minister of Rites, concurrent Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, and Duke of Liyang, was made Chief Minister; Zhang Xingcheng, Junior Steward of the Heir Apparent, concurrent Vice Director of the Left in the Masters of Writing, was made concurrent Chief Minister and Acting Minister of Justice; Gao Jifu, Right Aide to the Heir Apparent, concurrent Vice Minister of Personnel and Acting Minister of Revenue, was made concurrent Director of the Secretariat and Acting Minister of Personnel; Xu Jingzong, Left Aide to the Heir Apparent and Baron of Gaoyang, was made concurrent Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Yu Zhining, minister of rites and junior tutor to the heir, Duke of Liyang, became chief minister; Zhang Xingcheng, junior steward of the heir and vice director on the left in the Masters of Writing, became concurrent chief minister and acting minister of justice; Gao Jifu, right aide to the heir, vice minister of personnel and acting minister of revenue, became concurrent director of the Secretariat and acting minister of personnel; Xu Jingzong, left aide to the heir and Baron of Gaoyang, was also named minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 辛未，還京。

translations.literal: On xinwei, they returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌朔，皇太子即皇帝位，時年二十二。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the first day of the sixth month, the Heir Apparent assumed the imperial throne; he was then twenty-two.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the new moon of the sixth month, the heir took the throne; he was twenty-two.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「大行皇帝奄棄普天，痛貫心靈，若置湯火。

translations.literal: An edict said, "The late emperor has suddenly left all under Heaven; grief pierces the spirit as though one were cast into boiling water.
translations.idiomatic: He issued an edict: "The late emperor has suddenly forsaken all under Heaven; grief pierces the heart as though one stood in fire.

sentences.zh: 思遵大孝，不敢滅身，永慕長號，將何逮及。

translations.literal: Thinking to follow great filial piety, I dare not destroy my person; forever mourning with long cries—how can I ever reach him again?
translations.idiomatic: In great filial piety I dare not take my own life, yet endless mourning and long lament—how shall I ever reach him again?

sentences.zh: 粵以孤眇，屬當元嗣，思勵空薄，康濟黎元。

translations.literal: Alas, solitary and slight, I have fallen heir to the primal succession; I think to rouse my empty weakness and bring peace to the black-haired people.
translations.idiomatic: Alone and slight, I have inherited the primal succession; I mean to stir my meager strength and bring peace to the people.

sentences.zh: 敬順惟新，仰昭先德，宜布凱澤，被乎億兆。

translations.literal: Reverently following renewal, looking up to display the former virtue, it is fitting to spread triumphant grace over the hundred millions.
translations.idiomatic: In reverent renewal, looking up to the virtue of those before, let triumphant grace spread over the realm.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: A great amnesty for all under Heaven is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 內外文武賜勛官一級。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without are granted one rank of merit office.
translations.idiomatic: All civil and military officials at court and in the provinces receive one rank of merit office.

sentences.zh: 諸年八十以上賚以粟帛。

translations.literal: All persons eighty years of age and above are bestowed grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Those eighty years of age and above receive gifts of grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 雍州及諸州比年供軍勞役尤甚之處，並給復一年。

translations.literal: In Yongzhou and in prefectures where corvée for supplying the army has been especially heavy in recent years, tax and labor service are remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzhou and every prefecture lately crushed by army supply and corvée are granted a year's remission of tax and labor.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，改民部尚書為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: " On xinsi, the Ministry of the People was renamed the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi the Ministry of the People was renamed the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 疊州都督、英國公勣為特進、檢校洛州刺史，仍於洛陽宮留守。

translations.literal: Li Ji, Military Governor of Die Prefecture and Duke of Ying, was made Special Advancement and Acting Governor of Luozhou, remaining to guard Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ji, governor of Die and Duke of Ying, was promoted to special advancement and made acting governor of Luozhou, with orders to remain and guard Luoyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔司徒、揚州都督、趙國公無忌為太尉兼檢校中書令，知尚書門下二省事，餘並如故，賜物三千段。

translations.literal: On guiwei, an edict: Zhangsun Wuji, Minister of Education, Military Governor of Yangzhou, and Duke of Zhao, was made Grand Tutor and concurrent Inspector-General of the Secretariat, directing the Secretariat and Chancellery ministries; the rest as before; he was granted three thousand bolts of goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei an edict named Zhangsun Wuji, minister of education, governor of Yangzhou, and Duke of Zhao, grand tutor and concurrent inspector-general of the Secretariat, in charge of Secretariat and Chancellery affairs; his other posts stood; he received three thousand bolts of goods.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，特進、英國公勣為開府儀同三司、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On guisi, Li Ji, Special Advancement and Duke of Ying, was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the same privileges as the Three Excellencies and a seat in confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Ji, special advancement and Duke of Ying, was made grand master of splendid happiness with the same privileges as the three excellencies and a seat at confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，有司請改治書侍御史為御史中丞，諸州治中為司馬，別駕為長史，治禮郎為奉禮郎，以避上名。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingwu, the relevant offices asked to change Imperial Secretary to Censor-in-Chief, prefectural Administrators to Marshals, Vice-Prefects to Chief Administrators, and Ritual Clerks to Ceremonial Attendants, to avoid the emperor's name.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the seventh autumn month the relevant offices asked to rename imperial secretary as censor-in-chief, prefectural administrators as marshals, vice-prefects as chief administrators, and ritual clerks as ceremonial attendants, to avoid the emperor's taboo name.

sentences.zh: 以貞觀時不諱先帝二字，詔有司，奏曰：「先帝二名，禮不偏諱。

translations.literal: Because in the Zhenguan era the late emperor's two characters were not tabooed, an edict went to the offices; they memorialized, "The late emperor's two names—ritual does not require partial taboo.
translations.idiomatic: Since under Zhenguan the late emperor's two name-characters had not been tabooed, he ordered the offices to report; they replied, "The late emperor's two names need not be partially tabooed by ritual.

sentences.zh: 上既單名，臣子不合指斥。

translations.literal: Now that Your Majesty has a single name, ministers and subjects ought not to point and name it.
translations.idiomatic: But Your Majesty bears a single name; ministers and subjects should not speak it aloud.

sentences.zh: 」上乃從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor then followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor accepted their view.

sentences.zh: 己酉，於闐王伏闍信來朝。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Fokan, king of Khotan, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Fokan, king of Khotan, presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉朔，河東地震，晉州尤甚，壞廬舍，壓死者五千餘人。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the first day of the eighth month, an earthquake struck east of the River; Jin Prefecture suffered most—dwellings collapsed and more than five thousand were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the new moon of the eighth month, the east of the River shook; Jin Prefecture suffered worst—houses fell and more than five thousand were crushed.

sentences.zh: 三日又震。

translations.literal: Three days later it shook again.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later the earth shook again.

sentences.zh: 詔遣使存問，給復二年，壓死者賜絹三匹。

translations.literal: An edict sent envoys to inquire after the people, granted two years' remission, and gave three bolts of silk to families of the dead.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to comfort the people, granted two years' remission, and gave three bolts of silk for each person killed.

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司、英國公勣為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Li Ji, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Duke of Ying, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing with a seat in confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ji, grand master of splendid happiness and Duke of Ying, was appointed left vice director of the Masters of Writing with a seat at confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 僕射始帶同中書門下。

translations.literal: Vice directors from this time carried the concurrent title "with confidential counsel."
translations.idiomatic: From this time vice directors also bore the title "with confidential counsel."

sentences.zh: 庚寅，葬太宗於昭陵。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Taizong was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Taizong was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，加授鄜州刺史、荊王元景為司徒，前安州都督、吳王恪為司空兼梁州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Prince Jing of Jing, Military Governor of Bin, was further invested as Minister of Education; Prince Ke of Wu, former Military Governor of An, was made Minister of Works and concurrent Military Governor of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Prince Jing of Jing, governor of Bin, was further named minister of education; Prince Ke of Wu, former governor of An, became minister of works and governor of Liang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，贈太尉、梁國公玄齡，贈司徒、申國公士廉，贈左僕射、蔣國公屈突通，並可配食太宗廟庭。

translations.literal: On bingyin, posthumous Grand Tutor Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang, posthumous Minister of Education Liu Shiliang, Duke of Shen, and posthumous Left Vice Director Qu Tu Tong, Duke of Jiang, were all permitted to share sacrifice in Taizong's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin posthumous Grand Tutor Fang Xuanling, Duke of Liang, posthumous Minister of Education Liu Shiliang, Duke of Shen, and posthumous Left Vice Director Qu Tu Tong, Duke of Jiang, were all granted places at Taizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，以瑤池都督阿史那賀魯為左驍衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiazi, Ashina Helu, Military Governor of Jade Pool, was made General of the Left Martial Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eleventh winter month Ashina Helu, governor of Jade Pool, was made general of the left martial cavalry.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，晉州地又震。

translations.literal: On yichou, Jin Prefecture shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Jin Prefecture shook again.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 永徽元年永徽元年春正月辛丑朔，上不受朝，詔改元。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yonghui, in the spring of the first month, on xinchou, the new moon, the emperor did not receive court; an edict changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yonghui, on the xinchou new moon of the first spring month, the emperor declined court and proclaimed a new era name.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，御太極殿，受朝而不會。

translations.literal: On renyin, he took his seat in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and received court but held no assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he sat in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and received court without holding a full assembly.

sentences.zh: 丙午。

translations.literal: Day bingwu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu.

sentences.zh: 立妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Consort Wang was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Wang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以陳王忠為雍州牧。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Prince Zhong of Chen was made Military Governor of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Prince Zhong of Chen was made governor of Yong.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，封皇子孝為許王，上金為杞王，素節為雍王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinmao, the princes Xiao was enfeoffed as Prince of Xu, Shangjin as Prince of Qi, and Sujie as Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the second month the princes Xiao was created Prince of Xu, Shangjin Prince of Qi, and Sujie Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳朔，晉州地又震。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jisi, the new moon, Jin Prefecture shook again.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the fourth summer month Jin Prefecture shook again.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，上謂群臣曰：「朕謬膺大位，政教不明，遂使晉州之地屢有震動。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the emperor said to the assembled ministers, "I have wrongly received the great throne; my government and teaching are unclear, and therefore Jin Prefecture has repeatedly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor told his ministers, "I have unworthily taken the throne; my rule is unclear, and so Jin Prefecture keeps shaking.

sentences.zh: 良由賞罰失中，政道乖方。

translations.literal: Truly rewards and punishments miss the mark and the way of government is astray.
translations.idiomatic: Surely rewards and punishments are out of balance and the way of rule is wrong.

sentences.zh: 卿等宜各進封事，極言得失，以匡不逮。

translations.literal: You should each submit sealed memorials, speaking to the utmost of gain and loss, to correct my shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: Each of you should submit sealed memorials, speaking plainly of what is right and wrong, to repair my failings.

sentences.zh: 」吐火羅遣使獻大鳥如駝，食銅鐵，上遣獻於昭陵。

translations.literal: " Tokhara sent envoys presenting a great bird like a camel that ate copper and iron; the emperor sent it as tribute to Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: " Tokhara sent envoys with a great bird like a camel that ate copper and iron; the emperor had it presented at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃贊普死，遣右武衛將軍鮮於匡濟賚璽書往吊祭。

translations.literal: The Tibetan king died; the Right Martial Guard General Yu Kuaiji was sent bearing imperial writ to mourn and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan king died; the emperor sent Yu Kuaiji of the right martial guard with imperial writ to mourn and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，晉州地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengchen, Jin Prefecture shook.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the sixth month Jin Prefecture shook.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，以旱，親錄京城囚徒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingyin, because of drought he personally reviewed the capital's prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the seventh autumn month, because of drought, he personally reviewed the capital's prisoners.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，右驍衛郎將高侃執車鼻可汗詣闕，獻於社廟及昭陵。

translations.literal: On guimao, Gao Kan, commandant of the Right Martial Cavalry, brought Chebi Khagan captive to the palace, presenting him at the Altar of Soil and Grain and at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Gao Kan, commandant of the right martial cavalry, brought Chebi Khagan captive to court and presented him at the Altar of Soil and Grain and at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 己未，尚書左僕射、英國公勣固請解職，許之，令以開府儀同三司同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Li Ji, Left Vice Director and Duke of Ying, firmly asked to resign his post; this was granted, and he was ordered to remain Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with a seat in confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Ji, left vice director and Duke of Ying, firmly asked to leave office; the emperor agreed and kept him as grand master of splendid happiness with a seat at confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 十一月已未，中書令、河南郡公褚遂良左授同州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiji, Chu Suiliang, Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Henan, was demoted to Governor of Tong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiji, Chu Suiliang, director of the Secretariat and Duke of Henan, was demoted to governor of Tong.

sentences.zh: 十二月，瑤池都督、沙缽羅葉護阿史那賀魯以府叛，自稱可汗，總有西域之地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Ashina Helu, Military Governor of Jade Pool and Yabghu of the Shaboluo, rebelled with his commandery, styled himself khagan, and held all the lands of the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Ashina Helu, governor of Jade Pool and yabghu of the Shaboluo, rebelled with his district, took the title of khagan, and seized the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 是歲，雍、絳、同等九州旱蝗，齊、定等十六州水。

translations.literal: That year Yong, Jiang, Tong, and nine other prefectures suffered drought and locusts; Qi, Ding, and sixteen other prefectures suffered flood.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yong, Jiang, Tong, and nine other prefectures suffered drought and locusts; Qi, Ding, and sixteen others were flooded.

sentences.zh: 永徽二年二年春正月戊戌，詔曰：「去歲關輔之地，頗弊蝗螟，天下諸州，或遭水旱，百姓之間，致有罄乏。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yonghui, in the spring of the first month, on wuxu, an edict said, "Last year the lands about the passes suffered badly from locusts; throughout the empire's prefectures some met flood or drought, and among the people destitution arose.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yonghui, on wuxu of the first spring month, an edict said, "Last year the pass country was ravaged by locusts; across the provinces flood and drought struck, and the people fell into want.

sentences.zh: 此由朕之不德，兆庶何辜？

translations.literal: This is because my virtue is insufficient—what crime have the millions committed?
translations.idiomatic: This comes from my lack of virtue—what fault have the millions done?

sentences.zh: 矜物罪己，載深憂惕。

translations.literal: Pitying things and blaming oneself, I bear deep anxious fear.
translations.idiomatic: Pitying the realm and blaming myself, I am deeply afraid.

sentences.zh: 今獻歲肇春，東作方始，糧廩或空，事資賑給。

translations.literal: Now the offering year opens with spring and eastern tillage is just beginning; granaries in places stand empty, and relief must be supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Now spring opens the tribute year and eastern plowing begins; granaries in stricken places stand empty and must be filled by relief.

sentences.zh: 其遭蟲水處有貧乏者，得以正、義倉賑貸。

translations.literal: Where locusts and flood struck and the poor are in want, relief may be lent from the Ever-Normal and Righteous granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Where locust and flood left the poor in need, lend grain from the Ever-Normal and Righteous granaries.

sentences.zh: 雍、同二州，各遣郎中一人充使存問，務盡哀矜之旨，副朕乃眷之心。

translations.literal: For Yong and Tong, send one gentleman of the ministry each as commissioner to inquire after the people, striving to exhaust the intent of compassionate care and fulfill my heart of constant regard.
translations.idiomatic: Send one ministry gentleman each to Yong and Tong to comfort the people, with full compassion, as my constant care demands.

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，黃門侍郎、平昌縣公宇文節加銀青光祿大夫，依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: " On yisi, Yu Wenjie, Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Duke of Pingchang, was given the silver-blue-gleam grandee rank and remained with a seat in confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: " On yisi Yu Wenjie, vice director of the yellow gate and Duke of Pingchang, received the silver-blue-gleam grandee rank and kept his seat at confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 守中書侍郎柳奭為中書侍郎，依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Liu Shi, Attendant Secretary of the Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, remaining with a seat in confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shi, attendant secretary of the Secretariat, became vice director of the Secretariat with a seat at confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，秩太廟令及獻、昭二陵令從五品，丞從七品。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, the ranks of Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple and of the Directors of the Xian and Zhao Mausoleums were set at fifth grade; their assistants at seventh grade.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the fourth summer month the directors of the Imperial Ancestral Temple and of the Xian and Zhao mausoleums were ranked fifth grade; their assistants, seventh.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，開府儀同三司及京官文武職事四品、五品，並給隨身魚。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renchen, Grand Masters of Splendid Happiness and capital civil and military officials of the fourth and fifth grades were all given personal fish tally.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen of the fifth month grand masters of splendid happiness and capital officials of the fourth and fifth grades received personal fish tally.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，開府儀同三司、襄邑王神符薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinyou, Prince Shenfu of Xiangyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the sixth month Prince Shenfu of Xiangyi died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，賀魯寇陷金嶺城、蒲類縣，遣武候大將軍梁建方、右驍衛大將軍契苾何力為弓月道總管以討之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on dingwei, Helu raided and took Jinjiling and Pulei County; Liang Jianfang, General of the Martial Guard, and Qibi Heli, General of the Right Martial Cavalry, were made commanders-in-chief of the Bow-Moon campaign to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei of the seventh month Helu stormed Jinjiling and Pulei County; Liang Jianfang, general of the martial guard, and Qibi Heli, general of the right martial cavalry, were made commanders of the Bow-Moon campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，大食國始遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yichou, the state of Dashi first sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the eighth month the Arabs first sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，侍中、燕國公於志寧為尚書左僕射，侍中兼刑部尚書、北平縣公張行成為尚書右僕射，並同中書門下三品，猶不入銜。

translations.literal: On jisi, Yu Zhining, Chief Minister and Duke of Yan, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; Zhang Xingcheng, Chief Minister and concurrent Minister of Justice, Baron of Beiping, was made Right Vice Director, both with seats in confidential counsel, still not entering the titulary line.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Yu Zhining, chief minister and Duke of Yan, became left vice director of the Masters of Writing; Zhang Xingcheng, chief minister and minister of justice, Baron of Beiping, became right vice director—both with seats at counsel, still without titular rank in the line.

sentences.zh: 中書令兼檢校吏部尚書、條縣公高季輔為侍郎。

translations.literal: Gao Jifu, Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Acting Minister of Personnel, Baron of Tiao, was made Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jifu, director of the Secretariat and acting minister of personnel, Baron of Tiao, was made vice minister.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，改九成宮為萬年宮，廢玉華宮以為佛寺。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guisi, Jiucheng Palace was renamed Palace of Ten Thousand Years; Yuhua Palace was abolished and made a Buddhist monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the ninth month Jiucheng Palace was renamed Palace of Ten Thousand Years; Yuhua Palace was abolished and turned into a Buddhist monastery.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛未，頒新定律、令、格、式於天下。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinwei, the new statutes, ordinances, regulations, and forms were promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the intercalary month the new statutes, ordinances, regulations, and forms were promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，晉州地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao, Jin Prefecture shook.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the tenth winter month Jin Prefecture shook.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，有事於南郊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, he offered at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the eleventh month he sacrificed at the Southern Altar.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，定襄地震。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Dingxiang shook.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Dingxiang shook.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以高昌故地置安西都護府。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Protectorate General of Anxi was established on the former Gaochang lands.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he established the Protectorate General of Anxi on the former Gaochang territory.

sentences.zh: 白水蠻冠麻州，命左領軍將軍趙孝祖討平之。

translations.literal: The White-Water barbarians raided Ma Prefecture; the Left Palace Guard General Zhao Xiaozu was ordered to attack and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: White-Water tribesmen raided Ma Prefecture; the emperor ordered Zhao Xiaozu of the left palace guard to attack and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 永徽三年三年春正月癸亥，以去秋至於是月不雨，上避正殿，降天下死罪及流罪遞減一等，徒以下咸宥之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yonghui, in the spring of the first month, on guihai, because from last autumn until this month there had been no rain, the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced death sentences and exile by one degree throughout the realm, and pardoned all below hard labor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yonghui, on guihai of the first spring month, with no rain since last autumn, the emperor left the main hall, reduced capital crimes and exile by one degree empire-wide, and pardoned all below hard labor.

sentences.zh: 弓月道總管梁建方、契苾何力等大破處月硃耶孤注于牢山，斬首九千級，虜渠帥六千，俘生口萬餘，獲牛馬雜畜七萬。

translations.literal: Liang Jianfang, Qibi Heli, and others of the Bow-Moon command greatly defeated the Chuyue Zhu Ye Guzhu at Mount Lao; nine thousand heads were taken, six thousand chieftains captured, more than ten thousand living captives, and seventy thousand head of cattle and horses and mixed livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Jianfang, Qibi Heli, and the Bow-Moon command crushed the Chuyue leader Zhu Ye Guzhu at Mount Lao—nine thousand heads, six thousand chiefs taken, more than ten thousand captives, and seventy thousand cattle, horses, and mixed herds.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太尉、趙國公無忌以旱請遜位，不許。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Zhangsun Wuji, Grand Tutor and Duke of Zhao, because of drought asked to yield his place; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhangsun Wuji, grand tutor and Duke of Zhao, asked to step down because of drought; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 己巳，同州刺史、河南郡公褚遂良為吏部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On jisi, Chu Suiliang, Governor of Tong and Duke of Henan, was made Minister of Personnel with a seat in confidential counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Chu Suiliang, governor of Tong and Duke of Henan, became minister of personnel with a seat at confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 丙子，親祠太廟。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he personally sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he sacrificed in person at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，籍於千畝，賜群官帛有差。

translations.literal: On dinghai, he plowed the thousand-acre field and bestowed silk on the assembled officials in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he plowed the thousand-acre field and gave silk to the officials in graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，黃門侍郎、平昌縣公宇文節為侍中，中書侍郎柳奭為中書令。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinsi, Yu Wenjie, Vice Director of the Yellow Gate and Duke of Pingchang, was made Chief Minister; Liu Shi, Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the third month Yu Wenjie, vice director of the yellow gate and Duke of Pingchang, became chief minister; Liu Shi, vice director of the Secretariat, became director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸觀德殿，賜文武群官大射。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he visited the Hall of Observing Virtue and granted the great archery contest to civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he visited the Hall of Observing Virtue and held the great archery contest for the assembled officials.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，左領軍將軍趙孝祖大破白水蠻大勃律。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengyin, Zhao Xiaozu, Left Palace Guard General, greatly defeated the White-Water barbarian chief Bo Lü.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the fourth summer month Zhao Xiaozu, general of the left palace guard, crushed the White-Water chieftain Bo Lü.

sentences.zh: 甲午，澧州刺史、彭王元則薨。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Peng Prince Yuanze, Prefect of Li Prefecture, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Peng Prince Yuanze, governor of Li Prefecture, died.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，詔以周司沐大夫裴融，齊侍中崔季舒、給事黃門侍郎裴澤、尚書左丞封孝琰，隋儀同三司豆盧毓、御史中丞游楚客等，並門挺忠鯁，其子孫各宜甄擢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengchen, an edict ordered that Pei Rong, Director of Baths of Zhou; Cui Jishu, Attendant-in-Ordinary of Qi; Pei Ze, Supervising Secretary of the Yellow Gate; Feng Xiaoyan, Left Assistant of the Masters of Writing; Dou Lu Yu, Section Leader with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies of Sui; You Chuke, Imperial Censor; and the like—all clans renowned for loyal forthrightness—should have their descendants each selected and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen of the fifth month an edict singled out descendants of Pei Rong of Zhou, Cui Jishu of Qi, Pei Ze, Feng Xiaoyan, Dou Lu Yu of Sui, You Chuke, and other families famed for steadfast loyalty for promotion.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，立陳王忠為皇太子，大赦天下，五品己上子為父後者賜勛一轉，大酺三日。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingsi, Prince Zhong of Chen was established as Crown Prince; a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven; sons of fifth rank and above who were heirs to their fathers received one turn of merit; a great communal feast lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the seventh autumn month Prince Zhong of Chen was made crown prince; the court proclaimed a general amnesty, granted one grade of merit to fifth-rank heirs, and feasted the realm for three days.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，左僕射於志寧兼太子少師，右僕射張行成兼太子少傅，侍中高季輔兼太子少保，侍中宇文節兼太子詹事。

translations.literal: On yichou, Left Vice Director Yu Zhining was additionally made Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince; Right Vice Director Zhang Xingcheng was additionally Junior Preceptor; Attendant-in-Ordinary Gao Jifu was additionally Junior Guardian; Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuwen Jie was additionally Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yu Zhining, left vice director, became junior tutor of the heir; Zhang Xingcheng, right vice director, junior preceptor; Gao Jifu, attendant-in-ordinary, junior guardian; Yuwen Jie, attendant-in-ordinary, grand mentor of the heir.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上問戶部尚書高履行：「去年進戶多少？

translations.literal: On dingchou, the emperor questioned Minister of Revenue Gao Lüxing: "How many households were added last year?"
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he asked Gao Lüxing, minister of revenue, "How many households were registered last year?"

sentences.zh: 」履行奏稱：「進戶總一十五萬。

translations.literal: " Lüxing reported: "The total of added households was one hundred fifty thousand."
translations.idiomatic: Lüxing answered that additions came to one hundred fifty thousand households in all.

sentences.zh: 」又問曰「隋日有幾戶？

translations.literal: " He also asked: "How many households were there in Sui times?
translations.idiomatic: He pressed on: "How many did the Sui count?

sentences.zh: 今見有幾戶？

translations.literal: How many are there now on the registers?"
translations.idiomatic: And how many are on the books today?"

sentences.zh: 」履行奏：「隋開皇中有戶八百七十萬，即今見有戶三百八十萬。

translations.literal: " Lüxing reported: "In Kaihuang of the Sui there were eight million seven hundred thousand households; those now on the registers number three million eight hundred thousand."
translations.idiomatic: Lüxing replied: "At Sui Kaihuang, eight million seven hundred thousand; today, three million eight hundred thousand."
[End of the report.]

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，改太子中允為內允，中書舍人為內史舍人，諸率府中郎改為旅賁郎將，以避太子名。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingsi, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent was renamed Inner Mentor, Secretariat Draftsman was renamed Inner Scribe, and Central Guard lieutenants were renamed Brave Guards Commanders, to avoid the heir's personal name.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the ninth month titles bearing the heir's name were changed: crown prince mentor to inner mentor, draftsman to inner scribe, and guard lieutenants to brave guards commanders.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，幸同安大長公主第，又幸高陽長公主第，即日還宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu, he visited the residence of the Grand Princess of Tong'an, then the residence of the Princess of Gaoyang, and returned to the palace the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the tenth winter month he called on the Grand Princess of Tong'an and the Princess of Gaoyang and returned to the palace that day.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，駁馬國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yihai, Boma sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the eleventh month Boma sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，弘化長公主自吐谷渾來朝。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the Princess of Honghua came to court from the Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Princess Honghua came from the Tuyuhun to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，濮王泰薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guisi, Pu Prince Tai died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the twelfth month Pu Prince Tai died.

sentences.zh: 永徽四年四年春正月癸丑朔，上臨軒，不受朝，以濮王泰在殯故也。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first month of the fourth year of Yonghui, on guichou, the new year's day, the emperor took his seat at the hall but did not receive court, because Pu Prince Tai lay in mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, new year's day of the first spring month in Yonghui 4, he held court in the hall but accepted no congratulations while Pu Prince Tai lay in state.

sentences.zh: 丙子，新除房州刺史、駙馬都尉房遺愛，司徒、秦州刺史、荊王元景，司空、安州刺史、吳王恪，寧州刺史、駙馬都尉薛萬徹，嵐州刺史、駙馬都尉柴令武謀反。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the newly appointed Prefect of Fang Prefecture and Commandant of the Imperial Sons-in-Law Fang Yiai, Minister of Works and Prefect of Qin Prefecture Jing Prince Yuanjing, Minister of State and Prefect of An Prefecture Wu Prince Ke, Prefect of Ning Prefecture and Commandant of the Imperial Sons-in-Law Xue Wanche, and Prefect of Lan Prefecture and Commandant of the Imperial Sons-in-Law Chai Lingwu plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Fang Yiai of Fang, Jing Prince Yuanjing of Qin, Wu Prince Ke of An, Xue Wanche of Ning, and Chai Lingwu of Lan were charged with treason.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，遺愛、萬徹、令武等並伏誅；

translations.literal: In the second month, on yiyou, Yiai, Wanche, Lingwu, and the rest were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the second month Yiai, Wanche, Lingwu, and their accomplices were executed.

sentences.zh: 元景、恪、巴陵高陽公主並賜死。

translations.literal: Yuanjing, Ke, and the Princesses of Baling and Gaoyang were all ordered to take their own lives.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjing, Ke, and the princesses of Baling and Gaoyang were forced to suicide.

sentences.zh: 左驍衛大將軍、安國公執失思力配流巂州，侍中兼太子詹事、平昌縣公宇文節配流桂州。

translations.literal: Left Valiant Cavalry Guard General and Duke of the State of An Zhisi Sili was sentenced to exile in Song Prefecture; Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Duke of Pingchang, Yuwen Jie was sentenced to exile in Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhisi Sili, left valiant cavalry guard general and Duke of An, was exiled to Song; Yuwen Jie, attendant-in-ordinary and heir's grand mentor, Duke of Pingchang, to Gui.

sentences.zh: 戊子，特進、太常卿、江夏王道宗配流桂州，恪母弟蜀王愔廢為庶人。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Special Guardian and Minister of Ceremonies Jiangxia Prince Daozong was sentenced to exile in Gui Prefecture; Ke's younger brother by the same mother, Shu Prince Yin, was degraded to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Daozong, special guardian and minister of ceremonies, Jiangxia prince, was exiled to Gui, and Ke's uterine brother Yin, prince of Shu, was reduced to commoner rank.

sentences.zh: 己亥，絳州刺史、徐王元禮加授司徒，開府儀同三司、英國公勣為司空。

translations.literal: On jihai, Xu Prince Yuanli of Jiang Prefecture was additionally made Minister of Works; Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Duke of the State of Ying Ji was made Minister of State.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Xu Prince Yuanli of Jiang was also made minister of works, and Ji, Duke of Ying, was made minister of state.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子朔，頒孔穎達《五經正義》於天下，每年明經令依此考試。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, renzi, Kong Yingda's Correct Meaning of the Five Classics was promulgated throughout the realm; candidates in the classics examination were hereafter to be tested by it.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the first day of the third month, Kong Yingda's Correct Meaning of the Five Classics was issued empire-wide as the standard for the classics examination.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上御觀德殿，陳逆人房遺愛等口馬資財為五垛，引王公、諸親、蕃客及文武九品己上射。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the emperor took his seat at Guande Hall; the goods and horses of the traitors Fang Yiai and the rest were arranged in five piles, and princes, imperial kin, foreign guests, and civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above were invited to shoot at them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he sat at Guande Hall, piled the traitors' goods and horses in five stacks, and had princes, kin, foreign guests, and officials down to the ninth rank shoot at them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，林邑國王遣使來朝，貢馴象。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuzi, the king of Linyi sent envoys to court bearing tribute of tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the fourth summer month the king of Linyi sent envoys with tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以旱避正殿，減膳，親錄系囚，遣使分省天下冤獄，詔文武官極言得失。

translations.literal: On renyin, because of drought he avoided the main hall, reduced his meals, personally reviewed prisoners in bonds, sent envoys to inspect wrongful imprisonment throughout the realm, and ordered civil and military officials to speak frankly of gain and loss.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, citing drought, he left the main hall, ate sparingly, reviewed prisoners himself, sent inspectors to review jails empire-wide, and ordered officials to speak plainly of what the court did right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，隕石十八於同州之馮翊，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jihai, eighteen meteorites fell in Fufeng in Tong Prefecture with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the eighth month eighteen meteorites fell on Fufeng in Tong Prefecture with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，尚書右僕射、北平縣公張行成薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renyin, Right Vice Director and Duke of Beiping Zhang Xingcheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the ninth month Zhang Xingcheng, right vice director and Duke of Beiping, died.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，吏部尚書、河南郡公褚遂良為尚書右僕射，依舊知政事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Minister of Personnel and Duke of Henan Chu Suiliang became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, his other charge in governance remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Chu Suiliang, minister of personnel and Duke of Henan, became right vice director while retaining his seat in deliberations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，幸新豐之溫湯。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengzi, he visited the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the tenth winter month he went to the Xinfeng hot springs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，曲赦新豐。

translations.literal: On jiachen, a partial amnesty was granted to Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he granted a partial amnesty to Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On yisi, he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he returned from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，睦州女子陳碩貞舉兵反，自稱文佳皇帝，攻陷睦州屬縣。

translations.literal: On wushen, a woman of Muzhou named Chen Shuozhen raised troops in rebellion, styled herself Emperor Wenjia, and seized the subordinate counties of Muzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Chen Shuozhen of Muzhou rebelled, proclaimed herself Emperor Wenjia, and overran the counties of Muzhou.

sentences.zh: 婺州刺史崔義玄、揚州都督府長史房仁裕各率眾討平之。

translations.literal: Prefect of Wuzhou Cui Yixuan and Chief Administrator of the Yangzhou Protectorate Fang Renyu each led troops and pacified her.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yixuan of Wuzhou and Fang Renyu of Yangzhou each marched and put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，兵部尚書、固安縣公崔敦禮為侍中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guichou, Minister of War and Duke of Gu'an Cui Dunli became Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the eleventh month Cui Dunli, minister of war and Duke of Gu'an, became attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 頒新律疏於天下。

translations.literal: The new statutes with commentary were promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The revised code with commentary was promulgated empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，侍中兼太子少保、條縣公高季輔卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, Duke of Tiao, Gao Jifu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the twelfth month Gao Jifu, attendant-in-ordinary, junior guardian of the heir, and Duke of Tiao, died.

sentences.zh: 永徽五年五年春三月戊午，幸萬年宮。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third month of the fifth year of Yonghui, on wuwu, he visited Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the third spring month in Yonghui 5 he went to Wannian Palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，曲赦所經州縣系囚。

translations.literal: On xinwei, a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the districts he passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he granted a partial amnesty to prisoners along the route.

sentences.zh: 以工部尚書閻立德領丁夫四萬築長安羅郭。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Yan Lide was put in charge of forty thousand corvée laborers to build the outer walls of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Lide, minister of works, was ordered to raise forty thousand laborers to build Chang'an's outer ramparts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，守黃門侍郎潁川縣公韓瑗、守尚書侍郎來濟，並加銀青光祿大夫，依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Acting Supervising Secretary of the Yellow Gate and Duke of Yingchuan Han Yuan and Acting Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Lai Ji were both additionally made Silver-Gleaming Grand Masters of Splendid Happiness and still deliberated with the Secretariat and Chancellery as if of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Han Yuan of Yingchuan and Lai Ji were both promoted to silver-gleaming grand master while retaining third-rank deliberative rank.

sentences.zh: 閏五月丁丑夜，大雨，水漲暴溢，漂溺麟游縣居人及當番衛士，死者三千餘人。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month, on the night of dingchou, great rain fell; the waters rose violently and drowned the people of Linyou County and the guards on rotation, more than three thousand dead.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingchou in the intercalary fifth month torrential rain burst the rivers; more than three thousand people in Linyou and on guard duty drowned.

sentences.zh: 六月，恆州大雨，滹沱河泛溢，溺五千餘家。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Heng Prefecture had great rain; the Hutuo River overflowed and drowned more than five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month floods on the Hutuo at Heng Prefecture drowned more than five thousand households.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，蒲州汾陰縣暴雨，漂溺居人，浸壞廬舍。

translations.literal: On guichou, Fenyin County in Pu Prefecture had violent rain that drowned the inhabitants and damaged houses.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou a cloudburst at Fenyin in Pu Prefecture drowned residents and wrecked dwellings.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，中書令柳奭兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On guihai, Secretariat Director Liu Shi was additionally made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Liu Shi, director of the Secretariat, was also made minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河北諸州大水。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the districts of Hebei suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin great floods struck Hebei.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，有小鳥如雀，生大鳥如鳩於萬年宮皇帝舊宅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on xinsi, small birds like sparrows produced large birds like turtledoves at the emperor's former residence in Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the seventh month sparrow-sized birds at Wannian Palace hatched dove-sized young at the emperor's old residence.

sentences.zh: 八月，大理奏決死囚，總管七十餘人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Court of Judicial Review reported more than seventy persons sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Court of Judicial Review reported more than seventy death sentences.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔自今已後，五品已上有薨亡者，隨身魚並不須追收。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict ordered that from this time forward, when officials of the fifth rank and above died, their fish tally badges need not be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he decreed that fifth-rank officials and above would no longer have their rank badges reclaimed at death.

sentences.zh: 辛未，吐蕃使人獻馬百匹及大廬可高五丈，廣袤各二十七步。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Tibet sent envoys presenting one hundred horses and a great felt hall five zhang high, twenty-seven paces in length and breadth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Tibet sent envoys with one hundred horses and a great felt pavilion five zhang high and twenty-seven paces square.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，至自萬年宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingyou, he returned from Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the ninth month he returned from Wannian Palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，築京師羅郭，和雇京兆百姓四萬一千人，板築三十日而罷，九門各施觀。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on guiyou, the outer walls of the capital were built; forty-one thousand commoners of Jingzhao were hired, and rammed earth work ceased after thirty days; each of the nine gates was given a tower.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the eleventh winter month the capital's outer walls were raised; forty-one thousand Jingzhao households were hired for thirty days of rammed earth, and a watchtower was set on each of the nine gates.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，倭國獻琥珀、碼瑙，琥珀大如斗，碼瑙大如五斗器。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guichou, Wa sent tribute of amber and agate; the amber was as large as a peck-measure and the agate as large as a five-peck vessel.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou of the twelfth month Wa sent amber and agate, the amber the size of a peck and the agate of a five-peck jar.

sentences.zh: 戊午，發京師謁昭陵，在路生皇子賢。

translations.literal: On wuwu, he set out from the capital to visit Zhaoling; on the road the prince Xian was born.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he left the capital for Zhaoling; Prince Xian was born on the journey.

sentences.zh: 已未，敕二年一定戶。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict fixed household registers once every two years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he decreed a household census every two years.

sentences.zh: 永徽六年六年春正月壬申朔，親謁昭陵，曲赦醴泉縣民，放今年租賦。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first month of the sixth year of Yonghui, on renshen, the new year's day, he personally visited Zhaoling; a partial amnesty was granted to the people of Liquan County and this year's taxes and corvée were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, new year's day of the first spring month in Yonghui 6, he visited Zhaoling in person, pardoned Liquan, and remitted that year's taxes and labor.

sentences.zh: 陵所宿衛將軍、郎將進爵一等，陵令、丞加階賜物。

translations.literal: The generals and commanders who had guarded the tomb were each promoted one grade of nobility; the tomb magistrate and assistant were each raised in rank and given gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb guards of general and commander rank were each promoted one noble grade; the tomb magistrate and deputy were raised in rank and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至自昭陵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he returned from Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he returned from Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 於陵側建佛寺。

translations.literal: A Buddhist temple was built beside the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: A Buddhist temple was built beside the mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，封皇子弘為代王，賢為潞王。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Prince Hong was enfeoffed as Prince of Dai and Prince Xian as Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince Hong was made Prince of Dai and Prince Xian Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，皇太子忠加元服，內外文武職事五品已上為父後者，賜勛一級。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yisi, Crown Prince Zhong came of age; civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above who were heirs to their fathers received one grade of merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the second month Crown Prince Zhong received the capping rites; fifth-rank heirs among the officials received one grade of merit.

sentences.zh: 大酺三日。

translations.literal: A great communal feast lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: The court feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 三月，營州都督程名振破高麗於貴端水。

translations.literal: In the third month, Protector-General of Ying Prefecture Cheng Mingzhen defeated Goguryeo at Guiduan River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Cheng Mingzhen, protector of Ying, routed Goguryeo at Guiduan River.

sentences.zh: 嘉州辛道讓妻一產四男。

translations.literal: In Jia Prefecture, the wife of Xin Daorang gave birth to four sons at one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: In Jia Prefecture Xin Daorang's wife bore four sons at one birth.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，昭儀武氏著《內訓》一篇。

translations.literal: On renxu, Consort Wu Zhao composed one chapter of Inner Admonitions.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Consort Wu Zhao completed a chapter of Inner Admonitions.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，命左屯衛大將軍、盧國公程知節等五將軍帥師出蔥山道以討賀魯。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on guiwei, he ordered Left Guardian of the Left Palace Guard and Duke of the State of Lu Cheng Zhijie and four other generals to lead armies out by the Onion Mountains route to attack Helu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the fifth summer month Cheng Zhijie of Lu and four other generals were ordered to march by the Onion Mountains route against Helu.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎、潁川郡公韓瑗為侍中，中書侍郎、南陽男來濟為中書令。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary of the Yellow Gate and Duke of Yingchuan Han Yuan became Attendant-in-Ordinary; Secretariat Draftsman and Baron of Nanyang Lai Ji became Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yuan of Yingchuan became attendant-in-ordinary; Lai Ji of Nanyang became director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 兼吏部尚書、河東縣男柳奭貶遂州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Shi, additionally Minister of Personnel and Baron of Hedong, was demoted to Prefect of Sui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shi of Hedong, who also held the Ministry of Personnel, was demoted to prefect of Sui.

sentences.zh: 六月，大食國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Arabs sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Arabs sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，侍中、固安縣公崔敦禮為中書令。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Duke of Gu'an Cui Dunli became Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the seventh autumn month Cui Dunli, attendant-in-ordinary and Duke of Gu'an, became director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，均天下州縣公廨。

translations.literal: On yiyou, official residences throughout the districts and prefectures were equalized.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou official residences empire-wide were equalized in scale.

sentences.zh: 八月，尚藥奉御蔣孝璋員外特置，仍同正。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Palace Medical Attendant Jiang Xiaozhang was specially appointed as supernumerary and still treated as regular.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month palace medical attendant Jiang Xiaozhang was given a special supernumerary appointment with regular standing.

sentences.zh: 員外同正，自蔣孝璋始也。

translations.literal: Supernumerary with regular standing began with Jiang Xiaozhang.
translations.idiomatic: The rank of supernumerary with regular standing began with Jiang Xiaozhang.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大理更置少卿一員。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the Court of Judicial Review again established one additional vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Court of Judicial Review added a second vice director.

sentences.zh: 先是大雨，道路不通，京師米價暴貴，出倉粟糶之，京師東西二市置常平倉。

translations.literal: Earlier there had been great rain and the roads were impassable; grain prices in the capital soared; grain from the storehouses was sold to the people; and constant granaries were established in the eastern and western markets of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After heavy rains had blocked the roads and driven up grain prices, the court sold storehouse grain and set up relief granaries in the capital's eastern and western markets.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，尚書右僕射、河南郡公褚遂良以諫立武昭儀，貶授潭州都督。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu, Right Vice Director and Duke of Henan Chu Suiliang, for remonstrating against establishing Consort Wu Zhao, was demoted and made Protector-General of Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the ninth month Chu Suiliang, right vice director and Duke of Henan, was demoted to protector of Tan for opposing Wu Zhao's elevation as empress.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，洛州大水，毀天津橋。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Luoyang suffered great floods that destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou floods at Luoyang destroyed the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，廢皇后王氏為庶人，立儀武昭氏為皇后，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou, Empress Wang was deposed to commoner status and Consort Wu Zhao was established as empress; a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the tenth winter month Empress Wang was deposed and Consort Wu Zhao made empress; the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯朔，臨軒，命司空勣、左僕射志寧冊皇后，文武群官及番夷之長，奉朝皇后於肅義門。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the dingmao new year's day, he took his seat at the hall; he ordered Minister of State Ji and Left Vice Director Yu Zhining to invest the empress; civil and military officials and the chiefs of the foreign tribes attended the empress at Suyi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, new year's day of the eleventh month, he presided in the hall as Ji and Yu Zhining invested the empress; officials and foreign chiefs received her at Suyi Gate.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，皇后見於廟。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi, the empress was presented at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the eleventh month the empress was presented at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，追贈後父故工部尚書、應國公、贈並州都督武士彠為司空。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the empress's late father, the former Minister of Works, Duke of Ying, posthumously made Protector-General of Bing, Wu Shiyue, was posthumously made Minister of State.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wu Shiyue, the empress's late father and former minister of works, Duke of Ying, was posthumously made minister of state.

sentences.zh: 丙子，淄州高苑縣吳文威妻魏氏一產四男，三見育。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Wei of Gaoyuan County in Zi Prefecture, wife of Wu Wenwei, gave birth to four sons at one delivery, three of whom survived.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wei, wife of Wu Wenwei of Gaoyuan in Zi, bore four sons at once; three lived.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，應國夫人楊氏改封代國夫人。

translations.literal: On guisi, Lady Yang of the State of Ying was re-enfeoffed as Lady of the State of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Lady Yang of Ying was re-enfeoffed as Lady of Dai.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遣禮部尚書、高陽縣男許敬宗每日待詔於武德殿西門。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Minister of Rites and Baron of Gaoyang Xu Jingzong was ordered to attend daily at the western gate of Wude Hall as Awaiting Imperial Command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xu Jingzong, minister of rites and Baron of Gaoyang, was ordered to attend daily at the west gate of Wude Hall.

sentences.zh: 顯慶元年七年春正月辛未，廢皇太子忠為梁王，立代王弘為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first month of the seventh year, on xinwei, Crown Prince Zhong was deposed to Prince of Liang and Prince Hong of Dai was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the first spring month in Xianqing 1 Crown Prince Zhong was demoted to Prince of Liang and Dai Prince Hong made heir.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大赦，改元為顯慶。

translations.literal: On renshen, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Xianqing.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name to Xianqing.

sentences.zh: 文武九品已上及五品己下子為父後者，賜勛官一轉。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of the ninth rank and above and sons of the fifth rank and below who were heirs to their fathers received one turn of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the ninth rank and above and fifth-rank heirs received one grade of merit.

sentences.zh: 大酺三日。

translations.literal: A great communal feast lasted three days.
translations.idiomatic: The court feasted for three days.

sentences.zh: 甲子，尚書左僕射兼太子少師、燕國公於志寧兼太子太傅，侍中韓瑗、中書令來濟、禮部尚書許敬宗，並為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Left Vice Director and Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince, Duke of Yan, Yu Zhining was additionally made Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Attendant-in-Ordinary Han Yuan, Secretariat Director Lai Ji, and Minister of Rites Xu Jingzong were all made Guests of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Yu Zhining, left vice director and junior tutor, Duke of Yan, became grand tutor; Han Yuan, Lai Ji, and Xu Jingzong became guests of the heir.

sentences.zh: 始有賓客也。

translations.literal: The office of Guest of the Heir Apparent was established for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: The post of guest of the heir was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 御玄武門，餞蔥山道大總管程知節。

translations.literal: He took his seat at the Xuanwu Gate and gave a farewell feast for Cheng Zhijie, supreme commander of the Onion Mountains route.
translations.idiomatic: He held court at the Xuanwu Gate and feasted Cheng Zhijie, commander of the Onion Mountains campaign, on his departure.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，名《破陣樂》為《神功破陣樂》。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengyin, Battle Array Music was renamed Divine Merit Battle Array Music.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Battle Array Music was renamed Divine Merit Battle Array Music.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，贈司空武士彠為司徒、周國公。

translations.literal: On xinhai, posthumous Minister of State Wu Shiyue was made Minister of Works and Duke of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wu Shiyue was posthumously made minister of works and Duke of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，皇后祀先蠶於北郊。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinsi, the empress sacrificed to the Silkworm Ancestor at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the third month the empress sacrificed to the silkworm ancestor at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，戶部侍郎杜正倫為守黃門侍郎、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue Du Zhenlun became Acting Supervising Secretary of the Yellow Gate and deliberated with the Secretariat and Chancellery as if of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Du Zhenlun, vice minister of revenue, became acting supervising secretary with third-rank deliberative standing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，御安福門，觀僧玄奘迎禦制並書慈恩寺碑文，導從以天竺法儀，其徒甚盛。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wushen, he took his seat at Anfu Gate to watch the monk Xuanzang welcome the imperially composed inscription for Cien Monastery; the procession followed Indian ritual, and his followers were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen of the fourth summer month he watched from Anfu Gate as Xuanzang led the imperial inscription for Cien Monastery in Indian ceremony, with a vast following.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，太尉長孫無忌進史官所撰梁、陳、周、齊、隋《五代史志》三十卷。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao, Grand Mentor Zhangsun Wuji presented the thirty scrolls of the Monographs of the Five Dynasties Histories of Liang, Chen, Zhou, Qi, and Sui compiled by the historiographers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the fifth month Zhangsun Wuji presented thirty scrolls of monographs from the Liang, Chen, Zhou, Qi, and Sui histories compiled by the historiographers.

sentences.zh: 弘文館學士許敬宗進所撰《東殿新書》二百卷，上自製序。

translations.literal: Hongwen Guan academician Xu Jingzong presented the two hundred scrolls of the Eastern Hall New Books he had compiled; the emperor himself composed the preface.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwen academician Xu Jingzong presented his Eastern Hall New Books in two hundred scrolls; the emperor wrote the preface himself.

sentences.zh: 六月，岐州刺史、潞王賢為雍州牧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Prefect of Qi Prefecture and Lu Prince Xian became Protector-General of Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Lu Prince Xian of Qi became protector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，中書令兼檢校太子詹事、固安縣公崔敦禮為太子少師、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei, Secretariat Director and Inspector of the Heir Apparent's Affairs, Duke of Gu'an, Cui Dunli became Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince and still deliberated with the Secretariat and Chancellery as if of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the seventh autumn month Cui Dunli, director of the Secretariat and inspector of the heir's affairs, Duke of Gu'an, became junior preceptor while retaining third-rank deliberative standing.

sentences.zh: 改戶部尚書為度支尚書，侍郎亦然。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue minister was renamed Minister of Disbursements, and the vice minister likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The post of Minister of Revenue was retitled Minister of Disbursements, and the vice minister likewise.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，太子少師崔敦禮卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingshen, Palace Preceptor Cui Dunli died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingshen, Cui Dunli, preceptor to the heir, died.

sentences.zh: 左衛大將軍程知節與賀魯所部歌邏祿獲剌頡發及處月預支俟斤等戰於榆幕谷，大破之，斬首千餘級，獲駝馬牛羊萬計。

translations.literal: Left Guard General Cheng Zhijie fought at Yumugu Valley with the Qarluqs, Geluo, Zhifa, Yuezhi, and Yuzhi shihou under Qulluğ's command, routed them greatly, beheaded more than a thousand, and captured camels, horses, cattle, and sheep by the ten thousands.
translations.idiomatic: At Yumugu Valley, Left Guard General Cheng Zhijie crushed Qulluğ's Qarluq, Geluo, Zhifa, Yuezhi, and Yuzhi forces, taking more than a thousand heads and tens of thousands of camels, horses, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，初詔戶滿三萬已上為上州，二萬已上為中州；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guiyou, an initial edict ordered prefectures with thirty thousand households and above to be upper grade, and twenty thousand and above to be middle grade;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiyou, the court first ranked prefectures with thirty thousand households or more as upper grade and those with twenty thousand or more as middle grade;

sentences.zh: 先為上州、中州者各依舊。

translations.literal: those previously upper or middle prefectures each followed the old [rank].
translations.idiomatic: prefectures already so ranked kept their standing.

sentences.zh: 皇后制《外戚誡》。

translations.literal: The Empress composed "Admonitions for Empress Kin."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress composed Admonitions for Imperial Kin.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，括州海水泛溢，壞安固、永嘉二縣，損四千餘家。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Kuozhou seawater overflowed broadly, destroying An'gu and Yongjia two counties, damaging more than four thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen a tidal surge at Kuozhou wrecked An'gu and Yongjia counties and harmed more than four thousand households.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，初制都督及上州各置執刀十五人，中州、下州十人。

translations.literal: On xinsi, it was first decreed that area supervisors and upper prefectures each establish fifteen saber-bearers, middle and lower prefectures ten persons.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court first ordered area supervisors and upper prefectures to post fifteen saber guards each, and middle and lower prefectures ten apiece.

sentences.zh: 癸未，初置驃騎大將軍，官為從一品。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the post of Flying Cavalry Grand General was first established, rank being second-first grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the court created the post of Flying Cavalry Grand General at the second rank of the first grade.

sentences.zh: 程知節與賀魯男咥運戰，斬首數千級，進至怛篤城，俘其部落戶口及貨物巨積。

translations.literal: Cheng Zhijie fought Qulluğ's son Zhayun, beheaded several thousand, advanced to Tudu City, and captured his tribal households and goods in great accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhijie fought Qulluğ's son Zhayun, took several thousand heads, advanced to Tudu City, and seized vast herds of captives and booty.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙丑，皇子顯生，詔京官、朝集使各加勛級。

translations.literal: In the eleventh winter month, on yichou, the imperial prince Xian was born; an edict ordered capital officials and court-gathering commissioners each to receive added merit ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yichou, Prince Xian was born; capital officials and assembly commissioners received an additional merit rank each.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，置算學。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, the Mathematics School was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, the court established a school of mathematics.

sentences.zh: 左屯衛大將軍程知節坐討賀魯逗留，追賊不及，減死免官。

translations.literal: Left Army Guard General Cheng Zhijie, on account of campaigning against Qulluğ with delay and pursuing the bandits without catching them, had death reduced and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhijie, general of the Left Army Guards, was sentenced to death commuted for delaying pursuit of Qulluğ and was stripped of his post.

sentences.zh: 罷蘭州都督。

translations.literal: The Lanzhou area supervisor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Lanzhou military governorship was abolished.

sentences.zh: 鄯州置都督。

translations.literal: Shanzhou established an area supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: A military governor was installed at Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 顯慶二年二年春正月庚寅，幸洛陽。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianqing, spring first month, on gengyin, he visited Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianqing, on gengyin of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 命右屯衛將軍蘇定方等四將軍為伊麗道將軍，帥師以討賀魯。

translations.literal: He ordered Right Army Guard General Su Dingfang and four other generals to be Yili Circuit generals, leading armies to attack Qulluğ.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed Su Dingfang of the Right Army Guards and three other generals commanders of the Yili campaign to march against Qulluğ.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，入洛陽宮，曲赦洛州。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinyou, he entered Luoyang Palace; partial pardon for Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the second month he entered the Luoyang palace and granted Luozhou a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚午，封皇第七子顯為周王，徙封許王素節為郇王。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the seventh imperial son Xian was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhou; transferred enfeoffment of Prince of Xu Su Jie to Prince of Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the seventh prince, Xian, was created Prince of Zhou, and Prince Su Jie of Xu was retitled Prince of Xun.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，中書侍郎李義府為中書令兼檢校御史大夫，黃門侍郎杜正倫兼度支尚書，依舊同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiazi, Vice Director of Secretariat Li Yifu became Secretariat Director concurrent with investigating censor-in-chief; Vice Director of Yellow Gate Du Zhenglun concurrent Disbursements Minister, as before third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the third month Li Yifu became Secretariat director and acting censor-in-chief, and Du Zhenglun became vice director with concurrent charge of disbursements, both remaining chief ministers of the third grade.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙申，幸明德宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth summer month, on bingshen, he visited Mingde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen, he went to Mingde Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，還洛陽宮。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on dinghai, he returned to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dinghai, he returned to the Luoyang palace.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，侍中、潁川縣公韓瑗左授振州刺史，中書令兼太子詹事、南陽侯來濟左授臺州刺史，皆坐諫立武昭儀為皇后，救褚遂良之貶也。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingmao, Palace Attendant, Duke of Yingchuan Han Yuan was demoted left to prefect of Zhen; Secretariat Director concurrent Crown Prince Household Superintendent, Marquis of Nanyang Lai Ji demoted left to prefect of Tai — all on account of remonstrating to install Lady Wu as empress, rescuing Chu Suiliang's demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the eighth month Han Yuan, Duke of Yingchuan and palace attendant, was demoted to prefect of Zhen, and Lai Ji, Marquis of Nanyang and director of the Secretariat, to prefect of Tai — both for opposing Empress Wu's elevation and defending the exiled Chu Suiliang.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書、高陽郡公許敬宗為侍中，以立武后之功也。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites, Duke of Gaoyang Xu Jingzong became Palace Attendant, on account of merit in establishing Empress Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jingzong, Duke of Gaoyang and minister of rites, became palace attendant for his role in making Wu empress.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，度支尚書杜正倫為中書令。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengyin, Disbursements Minister Du Zhenglun became Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin, Du Zhenglun was appointed director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，親講武於許、鄭之郊，曲赦鄭州。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on wuxu, he personally lectured on warfare at the borders of Xu and Zheng; partial pardon for Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuxu, he personally reviewed troops between Xu and Zheng and granted Zhengzhou a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 遣使祭鄭大夫國僑、漢太丘長陳實墓。

translations.literal: He sent envoys to sacrifice at the tomb of Zheng grandee Guo Qiao and Han grand warden of Taiqiu Chen Shi.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to offer sacrifice at the tombs of Guo Qiao of Zheng and Chen Shi, grand warden of Taiqiu.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，還洛陽宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao, he returned to Luoyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, he returned to the Luoyang palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，改「皞」「葉」字。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the characters "hao" and "ye" were altered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court changed the characters hao and ye in certain names and titles.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，手詔改洛陽宮為東都，洛州官員階品並準雍州。

translations.literal: On dingmao, by imperial autograph edict Luoyang Palace was changed to Eastern Capital; Luozhou officials' ranks and grades all followed Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an autograph edict renamed the Luoyang palace the Eastern Capital and aligned Luozhou official ranks with those of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 廢穀州，以福昌等四縣，並懷州河陽、濟源、溫，鄭州汜水並隸洛州。

translations.literal: Gu Prefecture was abolished; with Fuchang and other four counties, together with Huai Prefecture's Heyang, Jiyuan, Wen, Zheng Prefecture's Yishui, all were attached to Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Prefecture was abolished; Fuchang and three other counties, together with Heyang, Jiyuan, and Wen from Huai and Yishui from Zheng, were all placed under Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 已巳，中書省置起居舍人兩員，品同起居郎。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Secretariat established two recorders-of-imperial-residence, rank equal to recorders-of-the-palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Secretariat added two court diarists of equal rank to the palace diarists.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以周王顯為洛州牧。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Prince of Zhou Xian was made Luozhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Prince Xian of Zhou was appointed governor of Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，分散騎常侍為左右各兩員，其右散騎常侍隸中書省。

translations.literal: On renwu, the scattered cavalry attendant-at-court was divided into left and right, two persons each; the right scattered cavalry attendant-at-court was subordinated to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the post of attendant cavalier was split into left and right, two each; the right attendants were attached to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 顯慶三年三年春正月戊子，太尉、趙國公無忌等修《新禮》成，凡一百三十卷，二百五十九篇，詔頒於天下。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianqing, spring first month, on wuzi, Grand Mentor, Duke of Zhao Wuji and others completed revision of New Rites, altogether one hundred thirty scrolls, two hundred fifty-nine sections; edict promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianqing, on wuzi of the first spring month, Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao and grand mentor, completed the New Rites in one hundred thirty scrolls and two hundred fifty-nine sections; the court ordered them promulgated empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，車駕還京。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingsi, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
