translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the second month the Emperor returned to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 壬午，親錄囚徒，多所原宥。

translations.literal: On renwu, he personally recorded prisoners; many were pardoned and forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he personally reviewed prisoners and pardoned many.

sentences.zh: 蘇定方攻破西突厥沙缽羅可汗賀魯及咥運、闕啜。

translations.literal: Su Dingfang broke the Western Turkic Shaboluo Khagan Qulluğ and Zhayun, Quechuo.
translations.idiomatic: Su Dingfang defeated the Western Turk khagan Qulluğ and his sons Zhayun and Quechuo.

sentences.zh: 賀魯走石國，副將蕭嗣業追擒之，收其人畜前後四十餘萬。

translations.literal: Qulluğ fled to Shiguo; deputy general Xiao Siye pursued and captured him, gathering his people and livestock before and after more than four hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Qulluğ fled to the state of Stone; deputy commander Xiao Siye ran him down and took more than four hundred thousand people and animals in all.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，西域平，以其地置濛池、昆陵二都護府。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the Western Regions were pacified; on their lands Mengchi and Kunling two protectorate offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Western Regions were pacified and the court created the Mengchi and Kunling protectorates on their lands.

sentences.zh: 復於龜茲國置安西都護府，以高昌故地為西州。

translations.literal: At Kucha state Anxi Protectorate was restored; on Gaochang's former territory Western Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Anxi Protectorate was restored at Kucha and Western Prefecture created on the old lands of Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 置懷化大將軍正三品，歸化將軍從三品，以授初附首領，仍分隸諸衛。

translations.literal: Pacifying-attachment Grand General of orthodox third grade, Submitting-to-transformation General of subordinate third grade were established, to invest newly submitted chieftains, still divided to be subordinated to the guards.
translations.idiomatic: The court created the Pacification-general at the third rank and the Submission-general at the lower third rank for newly submitted tribal leaders, who were then assigned to the guard regiments.

sentences.zh: 六月，程名振攻高麗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Cheng Mingzhen attacked Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Cheng Mingzhen marched against Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 九月，廢書、算、律學。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the schools of writing, mathematics, and law were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court abolished the schools of letters, mathematics, and law.

sentences.zh: 有司奏請造排車七百乘，擬行幸載排城；

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized requesting to build seven hundred cart barriers, planning for imperial progress to carry barrier-walls;
translations.idiomatic: The ministry asked to build seven hundred barrier carts to carry a mobile stockade on tour;

sentences.zh: 上以為勞民，乃於舊頓置院墻焉。

translations.literal: the Emperor considered it laborious to the people, and thus at the old halt established courtyard walls instead.
translations.idiomatic: the Emperor deemed it a burden on the people and had stockade walls built at the old encampment instead.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙酉，兼中書令、皇太子賓客兼檢校御史大夫、河間郡公李義府左授普州刺史，兼中書令、皇太子賓客、襄陽郡公杜正倫左授橫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh winter month, on yiyou, concurrent Secretariat Director, Crown Prince Guest concurrent investigating censor-in-chief, Duke of Hejian Li Yifu demoted left to prefect of Pu; concurrent Secretariat Director, Crown Prince Guest, Duke of Xiangyang Du Zhenglun demoted left to prefect of Heng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou, Li Yifu, Duke of Hejian and acting director of the Secretariat, was demoted to prefect of Pu, and Du Zhenglun, Duke of Xiangyang and concurrent director, to prefect of Heng.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎李友益除名，配流巂州。

translations.literal: Vice Director of Secretariat Li Youyi was struck from the rolls, assigned exile to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat vice director Li Youyi was struck from the registers and exiled to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，侍中許敬宗權檢校中書令。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Palace Attendant Xu Jingzong was provisional investigating Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu palace attendant Xu Jingzong was named acting director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊子，侍中、皇太子賓客、權檢校中書令、高陽郡公許敬宗為中書令，賓客已下如故；

translations.literal: On wuzi, Palace Attendant, Crown Prince Guest, provisional investigating Secretariat Director, Duke of Gaoyang Xu Jingzong became Secretariat Director, guest-of-crown-prince and below as before;
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Xu Jingzong, Duke of Gaoyang, became director of the Secretariat while keeping his post as crown-prince guest;

sentences.zh: 大理卿辛茂將為侍中。

translations.literal: Court of Review director Xin Maojiang became Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Maojiang, chief of the Court of Judicial Review, became palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚卿蕭嗣業於石國取賀魯至，獻於昭陵。

translations.literal: Court of State Ceremonial director Xiao Siye took Qulluğ from Shiguo and presented him at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: Chief of ceremonies Xiao Siye brought Qulluğ from the Stone Kingdom and presented the captive at Taizong's tomb.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，開府儀同三司、鄂國公尉遲敬德薨。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Pillar of State, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, Duke of E State Yuchi Jingde died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Yuchi Jingde, Duke of E and pillar of state, died.

sentences.zh: 顯慶四年四年春二月乙亥，上親策試舉人，凡九百人，惟郭待封、張九齡五人居上第，令待詔弘文館，隨仗供奉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianqing, spring second month, on yihai, the Emperor personally examined candidates by policy questions; altogether nine hundred persons, only Guo Daifeng, Zhang Jiuling and five others placed in upper grade, ordered to await imperial edict at Hongwen Academy, following the guard in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianqing, on yihai of the second spring month, the Emperor personally examined nine hundred candidates; only Guo Daifeng, Zhang Jiuling, and four others won top honors and were ordered to await appointment at the Hongwen Academy with the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 三月，以左驍衛大將軍、郕國公契苾何力往遼東經略。

translations.literal: In the third month, Left Martial Steeds Guard General, Duke of Bin State Qibi Heli was sent to Liaodong to oversee strategy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Qibi Heli, Duke of Bin and general of the Left Martial Steeds Guards, was sent to oversee Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己未，太子太傅、尚書左僕射、燕國公於志寧為太子太師，仍同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on jiwei, Crown Prince Grand Tutor, Left Vice Director of Masters of Writing, Duke of Yan State Yu Zhining became Crown Prince Grand Preceptor, still third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiwei, Yu Zhining, Duke of Yan and left vice director of the Masters of Writing, became grand preceptor to the heir while retaining his seat among the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，黃門侍郎許圉師同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On yichou, Vice Director of Yellow Gate Xu Yuanshi became third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Xu Yuanshi, vice director of the Chancellery, joined the chief ministers of the third grade.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太子太師、同中書門下三品、燕國公於志寧免官，放還私第。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Crown Prince Grand Preceptor, third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery, Duke of Yan State Yu Zhining was dismissed from office, released to return to private residence.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Yu Zhining, Duke of Yan and grand preceptor to the heir, was dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太尉、揚州都督、趙國公無忌帶揚州都督於黔州安置，依舊準一品供給。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Grand Mentor, Yangzhou area supervisor, Duke of Zhao Wuji bore Yangzhou area supervisor title while settled at Qian Prefecture, as before supplied according to first grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhangsun Wuji, Duke of Zhao and grand mentor, was banished to Qian Prefecture while retaining his nominal rank as Yangzhou governor and his first-grade stipend.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，兵部尚書任雅相、度支尚書盧承慶並參知政事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingshen, Minister of War Ren Yaxiang, Disbursements Minister Lu Chengqing both participated in knowing governance affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen, Ren Yaxiang, minister of war, and Lu Chengqing, minister of disbursements, joined the deliberative council.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，普州刺史李義府為吏部尚書，同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on renzi, Pu Prefecture prefect Li Yifu became Minister of Personnel, third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renzi, Li Yifu was recalled from Pu to become minister of personnel and chief minister of the third grade.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，皇太子加元服，大赦天下，文武五品己上子孫為父祖後者加勛官一級，大酺三日。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on yisi, the crown prince received capping ceremony; great pardon throughout the realm; civil and military fifth grade and above whose sons and grandsons were heirs to fathers and grandfathers added one merit officer grade; great communal feasting three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yisi, the crown prince came of age; the court proclaimed a general amnesty, granted an extra merit rank to fifth-grade officials and above who stood as heirs to their fathers or grandfathers, and ordered three days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 閏十月戊寅，幸東都，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month, on wuyin, he visited Eastern Capital; crown prince supervised the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the intercalary tenth month he went to the Eastern Capital and left the heir to govern.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，至東都。

translations.literal: On wuxu, he arrived at Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he reached the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以中書侍郎許圉師為散騎常侍、檢校侍中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Vice Director of Secretariat Xu Yuanshi became scattered cavalry attendant-at-court, investigating palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xu Yuanshi was made attendant cavalier and acting palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊午，兼侍中辛茂將卒。

translations.literal: On wuwu, concurrent Palace Attendant Xin Maojiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Xin Maojiang, concurrent palace attendant, died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以邢國公蘇定方為神丘道總管，劉伯英為昆夷道總管。

translations.literal: On guihai, Duke of Xing State Su Dingfang was made Shenqiu Circuit commander-in-chief, Liu Boying made Kunyi Circuit commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Su Dingfang, Duke of Xing, was made commander of the Shenqiu expedition and Liu Boying commander of the Kunyi route.

sentences.zh: 顯慶五年五年春正月甲子，幸並州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianqing, spring first month, on jiazi, he visited Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xianqing, on jiazi of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，至並州。

translations.literal: In the second month, on xinsi, he arrived at Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the second month he arrived at Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宴從官及諸親、並州官屬父老，賜帛有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he feasted attending officials and various kin, Bing Prefecture officials and elders, bestowing silk in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he feasted his entourage, kinsmen, and Bingzhou officials and elders, granting cloth and silk by rank.

sentences.zh: 曲赦並州及管內諸州。

translations.literal: Partial pardon for Bing Prefecture and all prefectures under its administration.
translations.idiomatic: Bingzhou and its circuit received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 義旗初職事五品已上身亡歿墳墓在並州者，令所司致祭。

translations.literal: At the banner-raising beginning, officials of fifth grade and above who had died with graves in Bing Prefecture — ordered the relevant offices to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered sacrifice for every fifth-rank founding official buried in Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 佐命功臣子孫及大將軍府僚佐已下今見存者，賜階級有差，量才處分。

translations.literal: Assist-the-mandate meritorious officials' descendants and great-general household staff and below now living — bestowed rank grades in varying measure, disposition according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: Living descendants of founding ministers and staff of the great-general households received graded promotions according to ability.

sentences.zh: 起義之徒職事一品己下，賜物有差。

translations.literal: Uprising followers, officials from first grade down — bestowed goods in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: Participants in the founding uprising below the first rank received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 年八十已上，版授刺史、縣令。

translations.literal: Age eighty and above — patent appointment as prefect or magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Men and women eighty or older were granted nominal posts as prefect or magistrate.

sentences.zh: 佐命功臣食別封身已歿者，為後子孫各加兩階。

translations.literal: Assist-the-mandate meritorious officials who had eaten separate enfeoffments but body already died — for their descendant sons each added two grades.
translations.idiomatic: For deceased founding ministers who had held separate fiefs, each surviving heir received two extra ranks.

sentences.zh: 賜酺三日。

translations.literal: Communal feasting bestowed three days.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted three days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 甲午，祠舊宅，以武士彠、殷開山、劉政會配食。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he sacrificed at the old residence; with Wu Shihuo, Yin Kaishan, Liu Zhenghui at accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he sacrificed at the old Taiyuan mansion, with Wu Shihuo, Yin Kaishan, and Liu Zhenghui as spirit associates.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，皇后宴親族鄰里故舊於朝堂，命婦婦人入會於內殿，及皇室諸親賜帛各有差，及從行文武五品以上。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingwu, the Empress feasted kin, neighborhood and old friends at court hall, ordered ladies of merit and women to enter meeting at inner hall, and various imperial kin bestowed silk each differing, and civil-military fifth grade and above who followed on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the third month the Empress feasted kin, neighbors, and old friends in the audience hall, summoned titled ladies and women to an inner gathering, and granted graded gifts of silk to the imperial clan, attendants of fifth rank and above, and the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 制以皇后故鄉並州長史、司馬各加勛級。

translations.literal: By decree, because of the Empress's hometown, Bing Prefecture chief administrator and vice administrator each received added merit rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted the chief and vice administrators of Bingzhou one merit rank each in honor of the Empress's birthplace.

sentences.zh: 又皇后親預會，每賜物一千段，期親五百段，大功已下及無服親、鄰里故舊有差。

translations.literal: Also the Empress personally attended the meeting; each time bestowed goods one thousand bolts, close kin five hundred bolts, lesser mourning and below and kin without mourning, neighborhood and old friends — varying.
translations.idiomatic: Where the Empress attended in person she gave a thousand bolts of goods to each honoree, five hundred to close kin, and graded gifts to more distant kin, neighbors, and old friends.

sentences.zh: 城內及諸婦女年八十已上，各版授郡君，仍賜物等。

translations.literal: Within the city and various women age eighty and above — each patent-appointed as district lady, still bestowed goods and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Every woman in the city eighty or older was titled district lady and given gifts besides.

sentences.zh: 己酉，講武於並州城西，上御飛閣，引群臣臨觀。

translations.literal: On jiyou, warfare was lectured at west of Bing Prefecture city; the Emperor mounted Flying Tower, leading ministers to observe from afar.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he held a martial review west of Bingzhou; from the Flying Tower he led his ministers to watch.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，發神丘道軍伐百濟。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Shenqiu Circuit army was dispatched to attack Baekje.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Shenqiu expedition marched against Baekje.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，左右領始改左右千牛。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Left and Right Lead-Guard were changed to Left and Right Thousand-Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Left and Right Lead Guards were renamed the Left and Right Thousand-Ox Guards.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，車駕還東都，造八關宮於東都苑內。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, on wuyin, the imperial carriage returned to Eastern Capital; built Eight-Pass Palace in Eastern Capital park interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuyin, he returned to the Eastern Capital and built the Eight-Pass Palace in the eastern park.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，至自並州。

translations.literal: On guihai, he arrived from Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he came back from Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，幸八關宮，改為合璧宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renxu, he visited Eight-Pass Palace, changed to United-Halves Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, he went to the Eight-Pass Palace and renamed it the United-Halves Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the gengwu new moon, the sun had an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the sixth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔文武五品己上四科舉人。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered civil and military fifth grade and above to present candidates in four categories.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict called on fifth-rank civil and military officials to nominate men in four examination categories.

sentences.zh: 甲午，駕還東都。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the carriage returned to Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Emperor returned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，廢梁王忠為庶人，徙於黔州。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on yisi, Prince of Liang Zhong was deposed to commoner, moved to Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yisi, Prince Zhong of Liang was degraded to commoner and exiled to Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，度支尚書、同中書門下三品盧承慶以罪免。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Disbursements Minister, third-grade co-equal with Secretariat and Chancellery Lu Chengqing was dismissed on account of crime.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Lu Chengqing, minister of disbursements and chief minister, was dismissed for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，蘇定方等討平百濟，面縛其王扶餘義慈。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Su Dingfang and others campaigned to pacify Baekje, bound its king Buyeo Yici face-forward.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Su Dingfang pacified Baekje and brought King Buyeo Yici forward bound.

sentences.zh: 國分為五部，郡三十七，城二百，戶七十六萬，以其地分置熊津等五都督府。

translations.literal: The state was divided into five departments, thirty-seven commanderies, two hundred cities, seven hundred sixty thousand households; on its territory were separately established Xiongjin and other five area-supervisor prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The realm had five provinces, thirty-seven districts, two hundred towns, and seven hundred sixty thousand households; the court divided the land into five military governorships including Xiongjin.

sentences.zh: 曲赦神丘、昆夷道總管已下，賜天下大酺三日。

translations.literal: Partial pardon for Shenqiu, Kunyi circuit commanders-in-chief and below; bestowed realm-wide great communal feasting three days.
translations.idiomatic: The Shenqiu and Kunyi commanders and their troops received a partial amnesty, and the empire was granted three days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，賜英國公勣墓塋一所。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu, granted Duke of Ying State Ji one tomb mound site.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, the court granted Li Ji, Duke of Ying, a tomb estate.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，代國夫人楊氏改榮國夫人，品第一，位在王公母妻之上。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on bingzi, Lady of Dai State the Yang clan was changed to Lady of Rong State, grade first, position above princes and dukes' mothers and wives.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingzi, Lady Yang of Dai was retitled Lady of Glory at the first rank, ranking above the mothers and consorts of kings and dukes.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌朔，邢國公蘇定方獻百濟王扶餘義慈、太子隆等五十八人俘於則天門，責而宥之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the wuxu new moon, Duke of Xing State Su Dingfang presented Baekje king Buyeo Yici, crown prince Yong and others, fifty-eight persons as captives at Zetian Gate, reproached yet pardoned them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the eleventh month Su Dingfang presented fifty-eight Baekje captives, including King Buyeo Yici and Crown Prince Yong, at Zetian Gate; the Emperor rebuked them and then spared them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，狩於許、鄭之郊。

translations.literal: On yimao, he hunted at the borders of Xu and Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he hunted between Xu and Zheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，至自許州。

translations.literal: On jimao of the twelfth month he returned from Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao of the twelfth month he came back from Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 龍朔元年六年春正月乙卯，於河南、河北、淮南六十七州募得四萬四千六百四十六人，往平壤帶方道行營。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longshuo, spring, first month, on yimao, from sixty-seven prefectures in Henan, Hebei, and Huainan forty-four thousand six hundred forty-six men were recruited and sent to the campaigning headquarters on the Pyongyang-Taebong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 1, on yimao of the first spring month, forty-four thousand six hundred forty-six men levied from sixty-seven prefectures across Henan, Hebei, and Huainan were marched to the Pyongyang-Taebong field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，以益、綿等州皆言龍見，改元。

translations.literal: On yiwei of the second month, because the prefectures of Yi, Mian, and others all reported dragons seen, the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the second month, after Yi, Mian, and other prefectures all reported dragon sightings, he changed the reign title.

sentences.zh: 曲赦洛州。

translations.literal: A selective amnesty was proclaimed for Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He issued a partial amnesty for Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 龍朔元年三月丙申朔，改元。

translations.literal: On the new moon, bingshen, of the third month of the first year of Longshuo, the reign title was changed again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the new moon of the third month in Longshuo 1, the era name was changed once more.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸合璧宮。

translations.literal: On renxu he proceeded to Hebi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he went to Hebi Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙申，命左驍衛大將軍、涼國公契苾何力為遼東道大總管，左武衛大將軍、邢國公蘇定方為平壤道大總管，兵部尚書、同中書門下三品、樂安縣公任雅相為浿江道大總管，以伐高麗。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the fifth summer month, Qibi Heli, Great General of the Left Martial Guards and Duke of Liang, was made Grand Commander of the Liaodong Circuit; Su Dingfang, Great General of the Left Martial Guards and Duke of Xing, was made Grand Commander of the Pyongyang Circuit; Ren Yaxiang, Minister of War, Same Rank as the Three Departments of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Duke of Le'an, was made Grand Commander of the Peijiang Circuit—all to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fifth summer month Qibi Heli, great general of the left martial guards and Duke of Liang, was named grand commander on the Liaodong front; Su Dingfang, great general of the left martial guards and Duke of Xing, grand commander on the Pyongyang front; and Ren Yaxiang, minister of war with a seat in confidential counsel and Duke of Le'an, grand commander on the Peijiang front—to strike Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇后請禁天下婦人為俳優之戲，詔從之。

translations.literal: That same day the empress requested that women throughout the realm be forbidden to perform as entertainers; an edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: That day the empress asked that women everywhere be barred from staging comic performances; the emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 甲子晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the month's last day, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，中書令許敬宗等進《累璧》六百三十卷，目錄四卷。

translations.literal: On gengyin of the sixth month, Palace Attendant Xu Jingzong and others presented Accumulated Jade Walls in six hundred thirty volumes and a catalogue in four volumes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin of the sixth month Xu Jingzong, palace attendant, and others presented the Accumulated Jade Walls—six hundred thirty juan with a four-juan catalogue.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，車駕還東都。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on guimao, the imperial carriage returned to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the seventh autumn month the court returned to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，令諸州舉孝行尤著及累葉義居可以勵風俗者。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the eighth month, an order was issued for all prefectures to recommend those of outstanding filial conduct and households of righteousness through successive generations who could encourage custom.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the eighth month he commanded every prefecture to commend men of exceptional filial piety and clans that had lived in mutual righteousness for generations, as models for the people.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，以河南縣大女張年百三歲，親幸其第。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the ninth month, because the elderly woman Zhang of Henan county was one hundred three years old, he personally visited her dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the ninth month, learning that Zhang, an elder of Henan county, was one hundred three, he visited her home in person.

sentences.zh: 又幸李勣之第。

translations.literal: He also visited the residence of Li Ji.
translations.idiomatic: He also called at the house of Li Ji.

sentences.zh: 天宮寺是高祖潛龍時舊宅，上周歷殿宇，感愴久之，度僧二十人。

translations.literal: Heavenly Palace Monastery had been Gaozu's old residence in his days before the throne; the emperor went up and walked through the halls, was moved to grief for a long while, and ordained twenty monks.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Palace Monastery had been the Gaozu emperor's dwelling before he took the dragon seat; the emperor climbed through its halls, lingered long in sorrow, and inducted twenty monks.

sentences.zh: 皇后至許圉師第。

translations.literal: The empress went to the residence of Xu Yanshi.
translations.idiomatic: The empress called on Xu Yanshi at his home.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徙封潞王賢為沛王。

translations.literal: On renzi Prince of Lu Xian was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Pei.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Prince of Lu Li Xian was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Pei.

sentences.zh: 是日，以雍州牧、幽州都督、沛王賢為揚州都督、左武候大將軍，牧如故。

translations.literal: That same day Prince of Pei Xian, Governor of Yongzhou and military governor of Youzhou, was made military governor of Yangzhou and Great General of the Left Martial Guards, retaining his governorship.
translations.idiomatic: That day Prince of Pei Li Xian, who was governor of Yongzhou and military governor of Youzhou, was also appointed military governor of Yangzhou and great general of the left martial guards, keeping his governorship.

sentences.zh: 以洛州牧、周王顯為並州都督。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhou Xian, Governor of Luozhou, was made military governor of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhou Li Xian, governor of Luozhou, was made military governor of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是日，敕中書門下五品已上諸司長官、尚書省侍郎並諸親三等已上，並詣沛王宅設宴禮，奏《九部樂》。

translations.literal: That same day an edict ordered all officials of the fifth rank and above in the Secretariat-Chancellery, heads of various offices, vice-directors of the Ministry of Civil Office, and all kin of the third degree of mourning and above to proceed to the Prince of Pei's residence to set out a banquet, and the Nine Section Music was performed.
translations.idiomatic: That day he ordered fifth-rank Secretariat-Chancellery officials and above, department chiefs, vice ministers of the civil office, and all relatives within three degrees of mourning to attend a feast at Prince Pei's mansion while the Nine Court Suites were played.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，賜帛雜彩等各有差。

translations.literal: When the ceremony ended, graded gifts of silks and brocades were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were finished he gave graded gifts of silks and patterned cloths.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，狩於陸渾。

translations.literal: In the tenth winter month, on dingmao, he hunted at Luhun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the tenth winter month he hunted at Luhun.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，還宮。

translations.literal: On guiyou he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he came back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，新羅王金春秋卒，其子法敏嗣立。

translations.literal: That year King Kim Chunchu of Silla died; his son Beopmin succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: That year King Kim Chunchu of Silla died and his son Beopmin took the throne.

sentences.zh: 龍朔二年二年春正月乙巳，太府寺更置少卿一員，分兩京檢校。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longshuo, spring, first month, on yisi, the Court of the Treasury was given one additional vice director to divide inspection between the two capitals.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 2, on yisi of the first spring month, the Court of the Treasury gained a new vice director to oversee both capitals.

sentences.zh: 丙午，東都初置國子監，並加學生等員，均分於兩都教授。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Directorate of Education was first established in the Eastern Capital; student posts and the like were increased and evenly divided between the two capitals for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the eastern capital first gained an imperial academy, with added student quotas split between both capitals for teaching.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，改京諸司及百官名：尚書省為中臺，門下省為東臺，中書省為西臺，左右僕射為左右匡政，左右丞為肅機，侍中為左相，中書令為右相，自餘各以義訓改之。

translations.literal: On jiazi of the second month, the names of offices in the capital and of hundred officials were changed: the Ministry of Civil Office became the Central Terrace, the Chancellery the Eastern Terrace, the Secretariat the Western Terrace, left and right vice premiers became left and right Rectifiers of Government, left and right vice directors became Masters of Protocol, Palace Attendants became left chancellors, Secretariat Directors became right chancellors, and the rest were altered according to analogous meanings.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the second month he renamed capital agencies and official titles: the Ministry of Civil Office became the Central Terrace, the Chancellery the Eastern Terrace, the Secretariat the Western Terrace; vice premiers became “rectifiers of government,” vice directors “masters of protocol,” palace attendants “left chancellors,” and secretariat directors “right chancellors”; every other office took a new name along the same lines.

sentences.zh: 又改六宮內職名。

translations.literal: The titles of the Six Palaces' inner offices were also changed.
translations.idiomatic: He also renamed posts within the Six Palaces.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，司戎太常伯、浿江道總管、樂安縣公任雅相卒於軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Ren Yaxiang, Minister of Rites for Military Affairs on the Peijiang Circuit, Duke of Le'an, died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Ren Yaxiang, circuit commander on the Peijiang front and Duke of Le'an, died in camp.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，自東都還京。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the third month he returned from the Eastern Capital to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the third month he came back to Chang'an from the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸同州。

translations.literal: On guichou he proceeded to Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he went to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 蘇定方破高麗於葦島，又進攻平壤城，不克而還。

translations.literal: Su Dingfang defeated Goguryeo at Reed Island, then advanced to attack Pyongyang but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Su Dingfang routed the Koreans at Reed Island, then besieged Pyongyang, failed to capture it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申朔，至自東都。

translations.literal: On the new moon, gengshen, of the fourth summer month, he arrived from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the new moon of the fourth summer month, he returned from the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，造蓬萊宮成，徙居之。

translations.literal: On xinsi Penglai Palace, newly built, was completed and he moved his residence there.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the new Penglai Palace was finished and he took up residence there.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，左侍極許圉師為左相。

translations.literal: On bingshen Xu Yanshi, Left Remonstrator, was made Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Xu Yanshi, left remonstrator, became left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復置律、書、算三學。

translations.literal: On yisi the three schools of law, writing, and reckoning were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he restored the schools of law, calligraphy, and arithmetic.

sentences.zh: 六月己未朔，皇子旭輪生。

translations.literal: On the new moon, jiwei, of the sixth month, the prince Xulun was born.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the new moon of the sixth month, Prince Xulun was born.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，初令道士、女冠、僧、尼等，並盡禮致拜其父母。

translations.literal: On yichou, for the first time, Daoist priests, female Daoists, monks, and nuns were all ordered to perform full rites and bow to their parents.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he first commanded Daoist priests and nuns and Buddhist monks and nuns to observe full filial obeisance to their parents.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，制蓬萊宮諸門殿亭等名。

translations.literal: On yihai the names of gates, halls, and pavilions in Penglai Palace were fixed by regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he set the names of Penglai Palace's gates, halls, and pavilions.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥朔，以東宮誕育滿月，大赦天下，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the new moon, dinghai, of the seventh autumn month, because the Eastern Palace had reached a full month since the birth, a general amnesty was proclaimed and feasting granted for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the new moon of the seventh autumn month, he marked the crown prince's child reaching one month with a general amnesty and three days of public feasting.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午，右相許敬宗乞骸骨。

translations.literal: On jiawu Right Chancellor Xu Jingzong requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Xu Jingzong, right chancellor, asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，許敬宗為太子少師，同東西臺三品，仍知西臺事。

translations.literal: On renyin Xu Jingzong was made Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince, Same Rank as the Three Offices of the Eastern and Western Terraces, and still managed Western Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Xu Jingzong became junior tutor to the crown prince with third rank at both terraces and kept charge of the western secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月，司禮少常伯孫茂道奏稱：「八品、九品舊令著青，亂紫，非卑品所服，望令著碧。

translations.literal: On autumn, ninth month, Sun Maodao, Vice Minister of Rites, memorialized: "For ranks eight and nine the old statute prescribed green, which mingles with purple—not fit for the humblest grades; I ask that they wear blue."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Sun Maodao, vice minister of rites, wrote: "Ranks eight and nine were once clad in green, which clashes with purple and does not suit the lowest offices; let them wear blue instead."

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，前吏部尚書、河間郡公李義府起復為司列太常伯，同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: On wuyin Li Yifu, former Minister of Civil Appointments and Duke of Hejian, left mourning and resumed office as Minister of Personnel, Same Rank as the Three Offices of the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Yifu, former minister of civil appointments and Duke of Hejian, left mourning and returned as minister of personnel with third rank at both terraces.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，幸溫湯，皇太子弘監國。

translations.literal: On tenth winter month dingyou he proceeded to the hot springs; Crown Prince Hong acted as regent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the tenth winter month he went to the hot springs while Crown Prince Hong governed the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁未，至自溫湯。

translations.literal: On dingwei he returned from the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he came back from the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，西臺侍郎上官儀同東西臺二品。

translations.literal: On gengxu Shangguan Yi, Vice Director of the Western Terrace, was made Second Rank at the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Shangguan Yi, vice director of the western secretariat, was raised to second rank at both terraces.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未左相許圉師下獄。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Left Chancellor Xu Yanshi was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the eleventh month Left Chancellor Xu Yanshi was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封皇第四子旭輪為殷王。

translations.literal: On guiyou the emperor's fourth son Xulun was enfeoffed as Prince of Yin.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the fourth son Xulun was made Prince of Yin.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，改魏州為冀州大都督府，改冀州為魏州。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the twelfth month, Weizhou was changed to the metropolitan area command of Jizhou, and Jizhou was changed to Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the twelfth month he swapped names: Weizhou became the Jizhou metropolitan command and Jizhou became Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 又以並、揚、荊、益四都督府並為大都督府。

translations.literal: The four area commands of Bing, Yang, Jing, and Yi were likewise all made metropolitan area commands.
translations.idiomatic: The area commands of Bing, Yang, Jing, and Yi were all elevated to metropolitan commands as well.

sentences.zh: 沛王賢為揚州大都督，周王顯為並州大都督，殷王旭輪遙領冀州大都督。

translations.literal: Prince of Pei Xian was made metropolitan military governor of Yangzhou; Prince of Zhou Xian of Bingzhou; Prince of Yin Xulun held titular command of the Jizhou metropolitan area.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Pei was named metropolitan governor of Yangzhou, Prince Zhou of Bingzhou, and Prince Yin Xulun titular metropolitan governor of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 左相許圉師解見任。

translations.literal: Left Chancellor Xu Yanshi was dismissed from his current post.
translations.idiomatic: Left Chancellor Xu Yanshi was relieved of office.

sentences.zh: 龍朔三年三年春正月，左武衛大將軍鄭仁泰等帥師討鐵勒餘種，盡平之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Longshuo, spring, first month, Zheng Rentai, Great General of the Left Martial Guards, and others led troops to subdue the remnant Tiele tribes and pacified them all.
translations.idiomatic: In Longshuo 3, in the first spring month, Zheng Rentai, great general of the left martial guards, and others marched against the remaining Tiele and subjugated them completely.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，司列太常伯李義府為右相。

translations.literal: On yichou Li Yifu, Minister of Personnel, was made Right Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Yifu, minister of personnel, became right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，隴、雍、同、岐等一十五州戶口，徵修蓬萊宮。

translations.literal: On bingxu household registers of fifteen prefectures including Long, Yong, Tong, and Qi were levied for labor to repair Penglai Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu labor was levied from fifteen prefectures—Long, Yong, Tong, Qi, and others—to repair Penglai Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，置太子左右諭德及桂坊大夫等官員，改司經局為桂坊館，崇賢館罷隸左春坊。

translations.literal: On guisi the crown prince's left and right moral advisers and Gui-Fang grandees and other posts were established; the Bureau of Classics was changed to the Gui-Fang Institute, and the Hall of Honored Worthies ceased to be subordinate to the Left Spring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he created the crown prince's moral advisers and Gui-Fang directors, renamed the classics bureau the Gui-Fang Institute, and detached the Hall of Honored Worthies from the left spring palace.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，減京官一月俸，助修蓬萊宮。

translations.literal: On dingyou capital officials' salaries for one month were reduced to assist in repairing Penglai Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he docked one month's pay from capital officials to fund Penglai Palace repairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔曰：「天德施生，陽和在節，言念幽圄，載惻分宵。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict said: "Heaven's virtue brings forth life; the yang harmony rests in the season. My thoughts turn to the dark prisons and sorrow cuts the night in two.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he decreed: "Heaven's virtue quickens life; yang warmth returns to its season. When I think of the jails my heart aches through the watches of the night.

sentences.zh: 雖復每有哀矜，猶恐未免枉濫。

translations.literal: Though there is pity time and again, I still fear that injustice has not been avoided.
translations.idiomatic: Though we often show mercy, I fear the innocent still suffer.

sentences.zh: 在京系囚應流死者，每日將二十人過。

translations.literal: Capital prisoners liable to death or exile shall be brought forward twenty each day.
translations.idiomatic: Let twenty condemned or exiled prisoners in the capital be brought before me each day.

sentences.zh: 」於是親自臨問，多所原宥，不盡者令皇太子錄之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he personally examined them; many were pardoned, and those not completed were ordered recorded by the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: He then questioned them himself, pardoned many, and had the crown prince review those not yet decided.

sentences.zh: 詔以書學隸蘭臺，算學隸秘閣，律學隸詳刑寺。

translations.literal: An edict placed the school of writing under the Orchid Terrace, the school of reckoning under the Secretariat Library, and the school of law under the Court of Detailed Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the calligraphy school placed under the Orchid Terrace, the arithmetic school under the imperial library, and the law school under the court of detailed punishments.

sentences.zh: 改燕然都護府為瀚海都護府，瀚海都護府為雲中都護府。

translations.literal: The Yanran Protectorate was changed to the Hanhai Protectorate, and the Hanhai Protectorate to the Yunzhong Protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Yanran protectorate became Hanhai, and Hanhai became Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 二月，前左相許圉師左遷虔州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, former Left Chancellor Xu Yanshi was demoted to prefect of Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month former left chancellor Xu Yanshi was demoted to prefect of Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 太子弘撰《瑤山玉彩》成，書凡五百卷。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Hong completed composition of Jade Splendor of Mount Yao; the work totaled five hundred volumes.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Hong finished the Jade Splendor of Mount Yao—five hundred juan in all.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，右相李義府下獄。

translations.literal: On yichou of the fourth summer month, Right Chancellor Li Yifu was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the fourth summer month right chancellor Li Yifu was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 戊子，李義府除名，配流巂州。

translations.literal: On wuzi Li Yifu was struck from the rolls and exiled to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Yifu was expelled from office and banished to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸蓬萊宮新起含元殿。

translations.literal: On bingwu he proceeded to the newly built Hanyuan Hall in Penglai Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he went to the new Hanyuan Hall at Penglai Palace.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸卯，彗星見於左攝提。

translations.literal: On guimao of the eighth autumn month a comet appeared at Left Sheti.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the eighth autumn month a comet appeared at Left Sheti.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔百僚極言正諫。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict ordered the hundred officials to speak remonstrance to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he commanded officials to speak plain counsel without reserve.

sentences.zh: 命司元太常伯竇德玄、司刑太常伯劉詳道等九人為持節大使，分行天下。

translations.literal: Dou Dexuan, Minister of Revenue, Liu Xiangdao, Minister of Justice, and nine others were appointed Credentialled Envoys to tour the realm in separate circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He named nine credentialled envoys—including Dou Dexuan, minister of revenue, and Liu Xiangdao, minister of justice—to tour the empire in separate circuits.

sentences.zh: 仍令內外官五品已上各舉所知。

translations.literal: Officials within and without the court of the fifth rank and above were further ordered each to recommend those they knew.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered every official inside and outside the court of fifth rank and above to recommend men they knew.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，絳州麟見於介山。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the tenth winter month a qilin appeared at Jieshan in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the tenth winter month a qilin was seen on Jieshan in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，含元殿前麟趾見。

translations.literal: On bingwu a qilin's hoofprint appeared before Hanyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu a qilin hoofprint appeared before Hanyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，雨冰。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the eleventh month there was freezing rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the eleventh month freezing rain fell.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，詔改來年正月一日為麟德元年。

translations.literal: On gengzi of the twelfth month an edict changed the first day of the first month of the coming year to the first year of Linde.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the twelfth month he decreed that the new year would open as Linde 1.

sentences.zh: 麟德元年麟德元年春正月甲子，改雲中都護府為單于大都護府，官品同大都督府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Linde, spring, first month, on jiazi, the Yunzhong Protectorate was changed to the Chanyu Metropolitan Command, its official grades the same as a metropolitan area command.
translations.idiomatic: In Linde 1, on jiazi of the first spring month, the Yunzhong protectorate became the Chanyu metropolitan command with the same rank as other metropolitan commands.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，加授殷王旭輪單于大都護。

translations.literal: On dinghai Prince of Yin Xulun was additionally appointed Chanyu Metropolitan Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Prince Yin Xulun was also named Chanyu metropolitan commander.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸萬年宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi he proceeded to Wannian Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he went to Wannian Palace.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，展大射禮。

translations.literal: On xinhai the great archery ceremony was extended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he expanded the great archery rites.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，長女追封安定公主，謚曰思，其鹵簿鼓吹及供葬所須，並如親王之制，於德業寺遷於崇敬寺。

translations.literal: On dingmao the eldest daughter was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Anding, posthumous name Si, and her guard of honor, musicians, and funeral provisions were all as for a full prince; she was moved from Deyie Monastery to Chongjing Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao his eldest daughter was posthumously made Princess of Anding, titled Si, with princely funeral honors and escort; her remains were moved from Deyie Monastery to Chongjing Monastery.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，衛州刺史、道王元慶薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth summer month, Prince of Dao Yuan Qing, military governor of Weizhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Prince of Dao Yuan Qing, governor of Weizhou, died.

sentences.zh: 五月，許王孝薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Prince of Xu Xiao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Prince Xu Xiao died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，於昆明之弄棟川置姚州都督府。

translations.literal: On yimao the Yaozhou Metropolitan Command was established at Nongdongchuan on Kunming Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he set up the Yaozhou metropolitan command at Nongdongchuan on Kunming Lake.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙子朔，至自萬年宮，便幸舊宅。

translations.literal: On the new moon, bingzi, of the eighth autumn month, he returned from Wannian Palace and at once visited his old residence.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the new moon of the eighth autumn month, he came back from Wannian Palace and went straight to his former home.

sentences.zh: 己卯，降萬年縣系囚，因幸大慈恩寺。

translations.literal: On jimao prisoners of Wannian county were pardoned, and he then visited Great Kindness and Grace Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he pardoned Wannian county prisoners and visited Great Kindness and Grace Monastery.

sentences.zh: 壬午，還蓬萊宮。

translations.literal: On renwu he returned to Penglai Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he went back to Penglai Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，兼司列太常伯、檢校沛王府長史、城陽縣侯劉祥道兼右相，大司憲竇德玄兼司元太常伯、檢校左相。

translations.literal: On wuzi Liu Xiangdao, Concurrent Minister of Personnel and Inspector of the Prince of Pei's Household, Marquis of Chengyang, was made Concurrent Right Chancellor; Dou Dexuan, Grand Censor, was made Concurrent Minister of Revenue and Inspector of the Left Chancellor's Office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Liu Xiangdao, marquis of Chengyang and inspector of Prince Pei's household, also became right chancellor; Dou Dexuan, grand censor, also became minister of revenue and inspector of the left chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，詔曰：「周京兆尹、左右宮伯大將軍、司衛上將軍、少塚宰、廣陵郡公宇文孝伯，忠亮存心，貞賢表志。

translations.literal: On jimao an edict said: "Yuwen Xiaobo of the Zhou, Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao, General of the Left and Right Palace Guards, General-in-Chief of the Guards, Junior Minister of the Royal Tombs, and Duke of Guangling, kept loyalty in his heart and integrity in his bearing.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he decreed: "Yuwen Xiaobo of Zhou—governor of Jingzhao, general of the palace guards, commander of the guards, junior tomb minister, and Duke of Guangling—was loyal in heart and upright in conduct.

sentences.zh: 淫刑既逞，方納諫而求仁；

translations.literal: When cruel punishments were let loose he still sought remonstrance and pursued humanity;
translations.idiomatic: When torture ran wild he still remonstrated and sought humanity;

sentences.zh: 忍忌將加，甘捐軀而徇節。

translations.literal: when jealous harm was about to fall he willingly gave his body to preserve his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: when malice was aimed at him he gladly gave his life for his duty.

sentences.zh: 年載雖久，風烈猶生，宜峻徽章，式旌胤胄。

translations.literal: Though years have passed, his fierce honor still lives; he should receive a lofty mark of distinction to glorify his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Years have passed, yet his fierce honor endures; let a lofty mark of distinction glorify his line.

sentences.zh: 其孫左威衛長史思純，可加授朝散大夫。

translations.literal: His grandson Sichun, Chief of the Left Majestic Guard, may be additionally granted Gentleman for Dispersed Service.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Sichun, chief of the left majestic guard, shall be further granted Gentleman for Dispersed Service.

translations.literal: Thus ended the edict.
translations.idiomatic: With that the edict closed.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，殺西臺侍郎上官儀。

translations.literal: On bingxu Shangguan Yi, Vice Director of the Western Terrace, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Shangguan Yi, vice director of the western secretariat, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊子，庶人忠坐與儀交通，賜死。

translations.literal: On wuzi the deposed heir Chen, convicted of communicating with Yi, was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the deposed heir Chen, found in contact with Yi, was granted death.

sentences.zh: 右相、城陽縣侯劉祥道為司禮太常伯。

translations.literal: Liu Xiangdao, Right Chancellor and Marquis of Chengyang, was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiangdao, right chancellor and marquis of Chengyang, became minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 太子右中護檢校西臺侍郎樂彥瑋、西臺侍郎孫處約同知政事。

translations.literal: Yue Yanwei, Right Central Guard of the Crown Prince and Inspector of the Western Terrace, and Sun Chuyue, Vice Director of the Western Terrace, were both made to participate in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Yanwei, crown prince's right central guard and inspector of the western secretariat, and Sun Chuyue, vice director of the western secretariat, were both given seats in confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 麟德二年二年春正月壬午，幸東都。

translations.literal: In the second year of Linde, spring, first month, on renwu, he proceeded to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Linde 2, on renwu of the first spring month, he went to the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸合璧宮。

translations.literal: On dingyou he proceeded to Hebi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to Hebi Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，慮雍、洛二州及諸司囚。

translations.literal: On wuzi he reviewed prisoners in Yong and Luo prefectures and various offices.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he reviewed prisoners in Yong, Luo, and the central offices.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以發向泰山，停選。

translations.literal: On jiazi, because the procession toward Mount Tai had begun, civil-service selection was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, with the fengshan procession under way, civil examinations were suspended.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，兼司戎太常伯、永安郡公姜恪同東西臺三品。

translations.literal: On jiayin Jiang Ke, Concurrent Minister of Military Affairs and Duke of Yong'an, was made Same Rank as the Three Offices of the Eastern and Western Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Jiang Ke, minister of military affairs and Duke of Yong'an, was given third rank at both terraces.

sentences.zh: 辛未，東都造乾元殿成。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Qianyuan Hall in the Eastern Capital was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Qianyuan Hall in the eastern capital was finished.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸酉，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the intercalary month, guiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the intercalary month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 四月丙午，曲赦桂、廣、黔三都督府管內大闢罪已上。

translations.literal: On bingwu a selective amnesty was proclaimed within the three area commands of Gui, Guang, and Qian for great felonies and above.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he issued a partial amnesty in the Gui, Guang, and Qian commands for capital crimes and above.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，講武邙山之陽，御城北樓觀之。

translations.literal: On bingyin military exercises were held on the south slope of Mount Mang; he watched from the northern city tower.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he held a military review on the south slope of Mount Mang and watched from the north city tower.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，左侍極、仍檢校大司成、嘉興縣子陸敦信為檢校右相，其大司成宜停。

translations.literal: On wuchen Lu Dunxin, Left Remonstrator and still Inspector-General of the Great Academy, Baron of Jiaxing, was made Inspector of the Right Chancellor's Office; his post as Inspector-General of the Great Academy was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Lu Dunxin, left remonstrator and inspector-general of the great academy, Baron of Jiaxing, became inspector of the right chancellor's office; his academy post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 西臺侍郎孫處約、樂彥瑋並停知政事。

translations.literal: Sun Chuyue and Yue Yanwei, Vice Directors of the Western Terrace, both ceased participating in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chuyue and Yue Yanwei, vice directors of the western secretariat, both left confidential counsel.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，以秘閣郎中李淳風造歷成，名《麟德歷》，頒之。

translations.literal: On xinmao Li Chunfeng of the Secretariat Library completed a calendar, named the Linde Calendar, and it was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Chunfeng of the imperial library finished a calendar called the Linde Calendar and it was issued.

sentences.zh: 以司空、英國公李勣，少師、高陽郡公許敬宗，右相、嘉興縣子陸敦信，左相、鉅鹿男竇德玄為檢校封禪使。

translations.literal: Li Ji, Minister of Works and Duke of Ying, Xu Jingzong, Junior Tutor and Duke of Gaoyang, Lu Dunxin, Right Chancellor and Baron of Jiaxing, and Dou Dexuan, Left Chancellor and Baron of Julu, were made Inspectors of the Fengshan Mission.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ji, minister of works and Duke of Ying; Xu Jingzong, junior tutor and Duke of Gaoyang; Lu Dunxin, right chancellor and Baron of Jiaxing; and Dou Dexuan, left chancellor and Baron of Julu were named inspectors of the fengshan mission.

sentences.zh: 六月，鄜州大水，壞城邑。

translations.literal: In the sixth month great floods in Fuzhou destroyed cities and towns.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month flooding in Fuzhou wrecked cities and towns.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，鄧王元裕薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month Prince of Deng Yuan Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Prince Deng Yuan Yu died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，皇后請封禪，司禮太常伯劉祥道上疏請封禪。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the tenth winter month the empress requested the fengshan ceremony; Liu Xiangdao, Minister of Rites, memorialized requesting the fengshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the tenth winter month the empress asked for fengshan; Liu Xiangdao, minister of rites, memorialized in support.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，高麗王高藏遣其子福男來朝。

translations.literal: On guihai King Gao Zang of Goguryeo sent his son Funan to court.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Goguryeo's King Gao Zang sent Prince Funan to court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，將封泰山，發自東都。

translations.literal: On dingmao, about to perform fengshan at Mount Tai, he set out from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, bound for fengshan at Mount Tai, he departed the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲大稔，米斗五錢，麰麥不列市。

translations.literal: That year the harvest was abundant; rice was five cash per dou, and wheat and barley did not even reach the markets.
translations.idiomatic: That year the harvest overflowed: rice sold for five cash a dou, and wheat and barley scarcely reached the markets.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，次於原武，以少牢祭漢將紀信墓，贈驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the eleventh month he halted at Yuanwu, sacrificed with the lesser tai-lao at the tomb of the Han general Ji Xin, and posthumously enfeoffed him as General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the eleventh month he stopped at Yuanwu, offered the lesser tai-lao at the tomb of the Han general Ji Xin, and posthumously made him General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，華州刺史、燕國公於志寧卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin Yu Zhining, military governor of Huazhou and Duke of Yan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yu Zhining, governor of Huazhou and Duke of Yan, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，御齊州大㕔。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the twelfth month he held great public feasting at Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the twelfth month he presided over great public feasting at Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，命有司祭泰山。

translations.literal: On yimao he ordered the relevant offices to sacrifice at Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he commanded the proper offices to perform the sacrifice at Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，發靈巖頓。

translations.literal: On bingchen he set out from Lingyan Station.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he departed from Lingyan Station.
